# DSH Intelligent UI **让 AI 的回答成为你可以操作的界面。** 在 DeepSeek Harness 对话中生成计算器、交互图表、地图、原理演示和小型应用。
从一句自然语言开始，完成「生成 → 交互 → 保存重放 → 追问」。 [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-0.2.1--rc.2-4D6BFE)](#兼容性) [![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-%3E%3D22.19-339933)](#快速开始) [![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-Host_%2B_Client-3178C6)](docs/architecture.md) [![MCP](https://img.shields.io/badge/MCP-stdio-6B7280)](#独立-mcp) **中文** · [English](README.en.md) [快速开始](#快速开始) · [演示视频](#demo-explanation) · [使用示例](#在对话中使用) · [工具清单](#工具清单) · [高德地图](#高德地图) · [开发文档](#开发与贡献)
--- ## 为什么使用它 有些问题，需要亲手调节参数、比较选项，或看一遍过程。 DSH Intelligent UI 为这些问题提供交互式呈现。你描述目标，当前 DSH 模型调用工具生成界面，插件负责校验、显示和保存。界面中的按钮还可以携带当前参数，经过你的确认后，将问题送回原会话继续讨论。 | 想做什么 | 可以生成什么 | 试着这样说 | | --- | --- | --- | | 搞懂一个原理 | 带参数、动画与公式的演示 | “用可调摆长的单摆解释周期。” | | 比较几种选择 | 对比卡片、评分或交互计算器 | “做一个三种方案的成本比较器。” | | 展示一组数据 | 表格、柱状图、饼图、折线图 | “把这些数值画成图，注明单位和来源。” | | 介绍地点或路线 | 地图、地点卡片、照片和行程播放 | “在地图上介绍某地的三个景点。” | | 做一个小工具 | 表单控件、计算器、DOM/SVG/Canvas 应用 | “生成一个可以直接操作的单位换算器。” | | 收集选择、展示进度 | 会议时间选择、只读工作流 | “让我从这三个会议时间中选择一个。” | ## 核心能力 - **在聊天里直接操作**：支持 HTML、CSS、JavaScript，以及 DOM、SVG、Canvas。生成过程中先显示静态预览，工具成功后再启用交互。 - **结果持续显示**：使用独立的聊天结果节点，保留工具返回的界面；支持历史重放、重置和单文件 HTML 导出。 - **界面跟随宿主**：适配 DSH 浅色/深色、字号和字体，内容自动测高，并显示可捕获的脚本运行错误。 - **常用组件开箱可用**：六种模板、结构化文本表格、内置 Chart.js 4.5.1 和 Leaflet 1.9.4，无需生成代码加载 CDN。 - **高德地图接入**：支持高德地点搜索与官方静态底图，保留地点标记、选点、缩放、平移和行程播放；Key 只在 Host 侧使用。 - **资源可追溯**：保留原有 OpenFreeMap 与百科/Commons 图片模式，展示地点来源和图片署名；个别地点无法定位时明确提示，其余已确认地点继续显示。 - **交互回到原会话**：追问经用户确认后提交，区分“等待确认”“已入队”和模型的运行、完成、失败或取消状态。 - **也能独立作为 MCP 使用**：复用文档校验、模板和 HTML 装配；适合需要自行接入渲染容器的客户端。 ## 快速开始 ### 兼容性 | 项目 | 当前要求与范围 | | --- | --- | | 插件版本 | `1.2.1` | | DSH 宿主 | **`0.2.1-rc.2`** | | 已验证的客户端路径 | Windows 发行版 CLI 启动的独立 **Web profile** | | Node.js | **22.19+**；当前本地验证使用 Node 24 | | 辅助启动脚本 | PowerShell 7，自动发现 Windows 发行版 CLI | | 模型 | 在 DSH 中配置，需能使用工具 | | DSH 源码 | 普通构建不需要；内部 Conversation 投影测试需要匹配标签源码 | ### 使用预构建包安装 已有 DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` 和正在使用的 Web profile 时，可以直接安装 Release 中的预构建包，无需克隆源码或本地编译： ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/NingTiAn-byte/dsh-intelligent-ui/releases/download/v1.2.1/dsh-intelligent-ui.tgz --ignore-scripts ``` 将 `web` 替换为实际 profile 名称。安装后按宿主提示刷新或重启；模型服务使用该 profile 自己的配置。下方是源码开发和独立实例的启动方式。 ### 1. 获取并构建 ```sh git clone https://github.com/NingTiAn-byte/dsh-intelligent-ui.git cd dsh-intelligent-ui npm ci npm run build npm run check ``` 构建使用锁文件中的 rc.2 SDK，不再依赖 alpha.4 源码链接。`lib/`、`dist/` 和预览页面都是生成产物；从 Git 获取源码后需要先构建。 ### 2. 离线预览 ```sh npm run preview ``` 这会生成并打开本地演示页面，无需配置模型。你可以检查控件、计算、重置与追问确认；预览中的追问只记录演示请求，不会发送到 DSH。 在无图形环境中只生成页面并打印位置： ```sh npm run preview -- --no-open ``` ### 3. 在发行版 DSH 中启动 确认已安装 DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`，在项目目录执行： ```powershell pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/run-dsh.ps1 ``` 脚本会构建插件、创建独立 `intelligent-ui` Web profile、通过官方插件管理器安装本地目录，然后启动并打开浏览器。默认端口为 `3098`；未设置 `DSH_HOME` 时，配置和会话放在项目的 `artifacts/dsh-home` 下。 在新打开的 DSH 中配置模型服务，再发送下面的测试提示词。独立 profile 不会自动复制你日常客户端的模型配置和凭据。
自定义启动路径、端口与配置检查 ```powershell # 端口已占用时 pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/run-dsh.ps1 -Port 3099 # 只安装并检查合成配置，不启动服务 pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/run-dsh.ps1 -Check # 不自动打开浏览器 pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/run-dsh.ps1 -NoOpen # 自定义发行版官方 CLI 的位置 pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/run-dsh.ps1 -DshCli '~\DeepSeek Harness\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd' ``` 也可通过 `DSH_CLI` 指定官方启动器，通过 `DSH_HOME` 指定数据目录，通过 `-Profile` 指定 profile 名称。脚本会检查宿主版本，遇到不匹配时停止。 若要装入已有 profile，请使用该客户端的插件管理入口或官方 `dsh plugin --profile add <本地项目目录>`，并确保使用同一个 `DSH_HOME` 和官方 CLI。上面的独立实例启动成功，不代表默认桌面 profile 已安装；桌面壳内的完整交互需另行验收。
## 在对话中使用 描述你需要的界面即可；为了首次确认工具链，建议明确要求调用工具。 ### 第一个交互界面 ```text 我想知道FFT算法的可视化表达是什么样的。 ``` **预期结果：** 在 DSH 对话中生成可交互的 FFT 原理演示。若希望调节采样点数、输入信号或逐步观察计算过程，可以在提示词中补充这些要求；具体交互取决于模型生成的界面。 #### 演示视频：FFT 原理可视化 实际操作录屏，约 49 秒：在聊天中查看 FFT 原理、切换输入信号并观察可视化结果。 https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b8585aaf-acec-4aef-8c22-271d9712d46f [查看或下载原始 MP4](docs/demos/explanation.mp4) ### 更多可复制的提示词
原理演示：单摆 ```text 生成一个交互式单摆演示，可以调节摆长和重力加速度。 提供开始、暂停和重置，展示周期公式、参数单位与理想模型假设。 ```
数据图表：有单位、有来源 ```text 用柱状图比较 A、B、C 三种方案的耗时：12、18、9 分钟。 数据来源注明“用户提供的演示数据”，保留可读的数据表。 ```
地理介绍：高德地点与行程播放 ```text 使用高德地图介绍上海的豫园、外滩、南京东路、陆家嘴、武康路和新天地，城市指定上海。 按地点名称查询，提供地点卡片、选点和行程播放，并保留来源链接。 ``` 需先按[高德地图](#高德地图)配置 Web服务 Key。高德底图是固定区域快照，放大不会加载新瓦片，站点连线不是道路导航；该模式不自动请求百科照片。原有 OpenFreeMap 模式仍可配合百科/Commons 图片使用。 首次准备地图需要联网。个别地点缺少可验证坐标时，会列入“尚未定位”提示，其余地点继续显示；所有地点均无法定位时才返回定位失败。底图下载、权限或配额错误会报告具体原因。
#### 演示视频：上海六站行程地图 实际操作录屏，约 15 秒：查看高德底图上的六个地点、地点卡片和行程播放。 https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f0c09349-31e8-40ab-8ec4-137fc49d2de1 [查看或下载原始 MP4](docs/demos/map.mp4)
交互小应用：小游戏 ```text 生成一个复古风格的打砖块小游戏，支持键盘操作。 提供开始、暂停、重新开始、分数和操作说明。 ``` 复杂游戏和科学模拟仍需实际操作确认逻辑正确性。
#### 演示视频：复古打砖块游戏 实际操作录屏，约 19 秒：展示聊天中生成的复古掌机界面与打砖块游戏。 https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/75ea5215-ed3f-4e43-b1ba-41be68d12751 [查看或下载原始 MP4](docs/demos/game.mp4) ### 如何验证主线 1. **模型调用工具**：检查轨迹；默认先选择展示形式，再调用 UI、表格或专项工具。 2. **显示交互界面**：确认出现卡片并能操作，而不只是模型声称“已生成”。 3. **保存与重放**：等待本轮结束，刷新并重新打开同一会话，确认保存的界面仍可渲染。 4. **追问回到会话**：在界面内发起追问，在宿主确认后，检查当前会话收到消息及模型回复。 保存的是界面文档和资源，**不保证保留滑块位置、游戏分数等临时运行状态**。重置或重新挂载会重新运行界面。导出的 HTML 可独立交互，但不能直接向 DSH 发送追问。 ## 工具清单 默认 `routing: model` 时注册 **11 个工具**。关闭展示路由后为 10 个；模型在某一阶段能看到的渲染工具还会随当前展示选择变化。 | 工具 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | `select_intelligent_ui_presentation` | 为当前用户消息选择 `text`、`table`、`ui` 或 `mixed`；由当前模型决定，无独立分类服务 | | `render_intelligent_ui` | 生成通用交互界面，分别提供 HTML、CSS 和 JavaScript | | `get_intelligent_ui_template` | 获取 `calculator`、`comparison`、`flowchart`、`chart_line`、`chart_bar`、`chart_pie` 模板 | | `render_intelligent_table` | 展示只读文本表格，最多 12 列、200 行 | | `render_intelligent_chart` | 通过结构化参数生成柱状图或饼图，附单位、来源与数据表 | | `render_intelligent_map` | 按配置使用高德底图快照或原有 OpenFreeMap 模式，展示地点、卡片和行程播放 | | `lookup_intelligent_ui_places` | 高德模式按名称与城市查询 POI，返回 GCJ-02 坐标；原有模式查询百科坐标，均保留来源 | | `search_intelligent_ui_images` | 搜索 Commons 图片文件名与署名，最多返回 4 项 | | `plan_intelligent_ui` | 展示可视化方案、技术选择和关键元素 | | `render_intelligent_workflow` | 展示只读任务状态快照，不执行或推进任务 | | `choose_intelligent_meeting_time` | 通过 DSH 人工问答选择会议时间，不创建预约 | 展示路由是同一个会话模型的一次工具选择。需要 UI 时，先完成选择，再在后续模型步骤调用渲染工具；不需要可视化的问题可以直接用文字回答。 注册实现：[Host 入口](src/index.ts) · [专项工具](src/host/features.ts) · [展示路由](src/host/routing.ts)。 ## 工作原理 ```mermaid flowchart LR A[用户描述需求] --> B[当前 DSH 模型] B --> C[选择展示形式并调用工具] C --> D[Host 校验并保存文档及资源] D --> E[持久聊天节点] E --> F[隔离 iframe 中显示和交互] D --> G[历史重放 / HTML 导出] F --> H[宿主确认追问] H --> B ``` Host 管理工具、资源获取和文档校验；Client 管理聊天节点、iframe、主题和消息桥接；DSH 继续管理模型、会话、队列与人工问答。界面资源保存在工具结果 metadata 中，重放时无需重新让模型生成整份界面。 生成代码在独立来源、`sandbox="allow-scripts"` 的 iframe 内运行。流式阶段不执行生成脚本；成功后启用脚本。追问和外链经受限桥接交给宿主确认。 工具失败时，卡片会显示可用的具体错误文本，历史重放也保留该错误；失败或中断的预览不会启用脚本。 ### 界面与会话桥接 ```javascript try { const receipt = await window.dshUI.sendPrompt('请解释当前参数对应的结果'); // 这里只代表确认/入队结果，不代表模型已经回复。 } catch (error) { // 处理用户取消或提交失败。 } const unsubscribe = window.dshUI.onRunStatus(event => { // 按 requestId 关联；completed 表示对应模型轮次完成。 console.log(event.requestId, event.status); }); ``` 还提供主题订阅、外链确认与错误报告。完整字段、版本和边界见 [运行契约](docs/runtime.md)。 ## 配置 ### 高德地图 高德模式使用 **Web服务 Key**：Host 调用地点搜索、坐标转换和官方静态地图接口，Leaflet 负责聊天卡片中的显示和交互。不需要申请 Web端（JS API）Key；当前实现也不是高德 JS 动态瓦片地图。 1. 在高德控制台为应用申请 **Web服务** Key。 2. 在插件根目录创建 `.env`，写入 `DSH_AMAP_KEY=你的高德Web服务Key`。默认自动读取该文件，与 DSH 的启动目录无关；修改后重启 DSH。也可用 `amapEnvFile` 指定其他 `.env` 路径。 3. 复制 [amap.example.yml](preview/amap.example.yml) 为 `preview/amap.local.yml`，填入真实文件路径： ```yaml - id: intelligent-ui config: mapProvider: amap # amapEnvFile: 'D:/keys/.env' # Optional; defaults to the plugin root .env amapTimeoutMs: 15000 ``` 4. 用覆盖层启动独立 Web profile： ```powershell pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/run-dsh.ps1 -I

# dsh-image-studio · 生图工作台

DeepSeek Harness 的多服务商生图插件：**Agnes / OpenAI GPT Image / Grok Image / OpenAI 兼容**，每个服务商独立 Key；侧边栏一级页面 + `/image` 斜杠命令，复用 `open-storyboard-canvas` 的 Agnes 请求契约，并补齐 OpenAI Images 与 Grok Imagine 接口。

![多服务商生图面板](docs/panel.png)

## 功能

- **四个服务商，四个独立 Key**：互不回退、互不覆盖；Key 只保存在本机插件目录，不写入 dsh 模型凭据或其他插件配置。
- **侧边栏一级入口**：与「插件」「自动化任务」「上下文洞察」同级，点击直接打开完整面板。
- **完整面板**：服务商切换、模型/尺寸/比例/质量、提示词、Ctrl/⌘+Enter、结果预览、**下载原图**、复制路径、最近 80 张历史。
- **`/image` 命令**：`/image --provider openai --size 1024x1024 --quality high <提示词>`，直接在对话命令面出图。
- **与 dsh 主题融合**：使用 `--dsw-alias-*`、`--dsh-frame-top-clearance` 等实时 token。
- **明确失败**：未配置 / 401 / 402 / 429 / 超时 / 网络 / 无图片数据分别有可执行提示。

## 服务商

| id | 面板名称 | 默认 Base URL | 默认模型 | 参数形态 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `agnes` | Agnes | `https://apihub.agnes-ai.cn` | `agnes-image-2.5-flash` | `size` 档位 1K–4K + `ratio` |
| `openai` | OpenAI GPT Image | `https://api.openai.com` | `gpt-image-1.5` | 像素 `size` + `quality`；DALL·E 3 自动切换尺寸/质量 |
| `grok` | Grok Image | `https://api.x.ai` | `grok-imagine-image-2.0` | `aspect_ratio` + `resolution`（1K/2K）+ `quality` |
| `openai-compatible` | OpenAI 兼容 | `https://api.example.com` | `gpt-image-1` | 自己填 Base URL / 接口路径 / 模型，标准 Images body |

OpenAI 兼容档可接任意 `POST /images/generations` 风格的中转/聚合器；模型名、尺寸、接口路径都可以在面板里改。

## 安装

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/david-zdw/dsh-image-studio.git

# 在 DSH profile 中安装这个本地包（路径换成你的 clone 目录）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:D:/path/to/dsh-image-studio
# macOS / Linux:
# dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:/path/to/dsh-image-studio
```

也可以在 DSH 插件管理器里选择 `install_bundle`，目标目录指向 clone 下来的仓库。

安装后侧边栏出现「生图工作台」。如果当前窗口是在安装前启动的，重新加载窗口/重启 DSH 一次即可。卸载：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-image-studio
```

## 使用

1. 点击侧边栏「生图工作台」。
2. 选择服务商页签（Agnes / GPT Image / Grok / 兼容接口）。
3. 点右上角「配置」，给**当前服务商**填 Key、Base URL、模型、默认参数。
4. 输入提示词，点「生成图片」。
5. 生成后结果右上角有「下载原图」（PNG/JPEG/WebP）和「复制路径」。

或直接发送：

```text
/image gpt 2k 16:9 一只戴宇航头盔的橘猫
/image grok 2k 9:16 雨夜霓虹街道
/image agnes 1k 1:1 电影感棚拍
/image 2k 16:9 默认服务商出图

# 也支持显式参数（老写法）
/image --provider openai --size 1024x1024 --quality high 一只戴宇航头盔的橘猫
```

提示：GPT Image 没有 2K/4K 档，`gpt 2k 16:9` 会映射为 `1536x1024`（竖图为 `1024x1536`，方形为 `1024x1024`）；Grok/Agnes 保留原生 2K 档。

简写规则：**开头的服务商/尺寸/比例可以任意顺序写**，遇到第一个不认识的词就开始当提示词。`gpt 2k 16:9`、`grok 2k 9:16`、`agnes 1k 1:1`、`2k 16:9` 都行。

`--provider` 支持 `agnes`、`openai`（别名 `gpt`）、`grok`、`openai-compatible`（别名 `compatible`/`custom`）。

## 数据位置

| 路径 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| `$DSH_HOME/image-studio/credentials.json` | `{ "keys": { "agnes": "...", "openai": "...", "grok": "...", "openai-compatible": "..." } }` |
| `$DSH_HOME/image-studio/config.json` | `defaultProvider` 与每个服务商的 Base URL / 模型 / 默认参数 |
| `$DSH_HOME/image-studio/history.json` | 最近 80 条生成元数据（含 provider） |
| `$DSH_HOME/image-studio/outputs/` | 生成的 PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF |

`$DSH_HOME` 默认是 `~/.dsh`（Windows：`C:\Users\<你>\.dsh`）。

## 配置字段

顶层：

| 字段 | 默认值 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | 总开关 |
| `defaultProvider` | `agnes` | `/image` 未写 `--provider` 时使用；点击面板服务商页签会自动更新 |
| `providers.<id>.*` | 见下表 | 每个服务商的独立配置 |

每个 `providers.<id>`：

| 字段 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `baseUrl` | 根地址；不能带查询参数 |
| `endpointPath` | 默认 `/v1/images/generations`，兼容中转可改 |
| `model` | 默认模型 |
| `size` | 默认尺寸；Agnes/Grok 用 1K/2K，OpenAI 用 1024x1024 等 |
| `ratio` | 仅 Agnes/Grok 使用 |
| `quality` | 仅 OpenAI/Grok 使用 |

Key 的环境变量兜底（文件 Key 优先）：

| 服务商 | 环境变量 |
|---|---|
| Agnes | `DSH_IMAGE_STUDIO_AGNES_API_KEY`，兼容旧 `DSH_IMAGE_STUDIO_API_KEY` |
| OpenAI | `DSH_IMAGE_STUDIO_OPENAI_API_KEY` |
| Grok | `DSH_IMAGE_STUDIO_GROK_API_KEY` |
| 兼容接口 | `DSH_IMAGE_STUDIO_OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_API_KEY` |

Key 优先级：**`credentials.json` 中该服务商的 Key > 该服务商环境变量 > 无**；不会读取其他服务商的 Key，也不会读取 dsh 的模型凭据。

## 开发与测试

```powershell
# 四服务商宿主冒烟（mock 上游）：Key 隔离、请求体、/image、文件路由
$env:DSH_HOME='D:\deepseek\_smoke-home'
node scripts/smoke-host.mjs
```

设计、请求映射、Key 存储、两条调用链路和改动点见 [docs/design.md](docs/design.md)。

## 备注

- GPT Image 使用标准 `/v1/images/generations` JSON body；参考图编辑走 `/v1/images/edits` multipart，当前面板暂未开放。
- Grok Imagine 使用 `grok-imagine-image-2.0` 的 `aspect_ratio` + `resolution` + `quality`；如果 xAI 改了参数，Base URL/模型可改，body 变更需要同步 `lib/providers.js`。
- OpenAI 兼容档的 `auto` 尺寸会省略 `size` 字段，尽量兼容不同中转。

plugins.description: Draws mermaid code blocks in DSH replies as diagrams, including while the reply is still streaming.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-mermaid Draws ```` ```mermaid ```` code blocks in DSH replies as diagrams — **including while the reply is still streaming**.

> dsh-plugin-mermaid — 把回复里的 ```mermaid 代码块画成图表，边流式输出边画
中文说明（点开） —— 不用等一轮回复结束才看到图 **它是什么**：模型在回复里写 ```` ```mermaid ```` 围栏，你看到的是图，不是代码。图上方一条细栏写着 `Mermaid`，右边是 **复制** 和 **源码/图表** 开关。 **为什么不是"等回复结束再画"**：DSH 渲染流式回复时，**已完成的块只解析一次、React 元素被缓存**，每个 token 只重建尾部那一块。所以规则只有一条：**源文本静止 220ms 才画**。token 在流 → 计时器一直被重置 → 什么都不画；围栏一闭、后面的正文开始到达 → 块冻结 → 图立刻出现。模型在围栏里停顿时不会画出半张图。 **复制**：图模式复制一张 PNG（2–3 倍尺寸、铺了代码块自己的底色，粘到文档里就是一张图）；源码模式复制 Mermaid 文本。浏览器剪贴板不收 SVG，所以图是先栅格化再写的 —— 这也是 Mermaid 跑在 `htmlLabels: false` 的原因：`` 里的 HTML 在"SVG 当图片"时会消失。 **认不出来就不画**：Mermaid 解析失败的块原样保留，不插任何东西。 **装法**：Plugin Manager 的 Add plugin 填 `github:kjx-talesofai/dsh-plugin-mermaid#v0.2.1`，或指向本地目录。装完**重启 app**（Host 半边开机才加载资产路由），页面再 **⌘R**。 **它没有做什么**：不改 Markdown 渲染器、不占槽位、不加工具。只在代码块的 `data-code-block-content` 里加一个节点，用一条 `:has()` 规则把源码 `
` 藏起来。
## What it does The model writes a fenced block: ````text ```mermaid flowchart LR A["工作区"] --> B["暂存区"] --> C["仓库"] ``` ```` You see the diagram, under a small bar that names it and offers **源码** (source) and copy. The block's own "Code block" banner is hidden while the diagram is shown, because the plugin never touches the `
` React owns — it
adds a sibling and hides the original with CSS.

**Copy follows the view.** With the diagram on screen the button puts a PNG on
the clipboard (2–3× the drawn size, on the block's own surface colour, so it
pastes into a document without a transparent-background surprise); with the
source on screen it copies the Mermaid text. Browser clipboards will not take an
SVG reliably, so the diagram is drawn through a canvas first — which is also why
Mermaid runs with `htmlLabels: false`: `foreignObject` HTML does not survive that
trip.

## Why this is not a Markdown plugin

There is no slot between "Markdown" and "code block". The only seat a plugin can
take is the whole `assistant-step` node, and taking it would mean re-implementing
Markdown — file links, image lightboxes, KaTeX, syntax highlighting, copy
buttons, sticky banners — to add one block type.

So the plugin decorates the primitive's own markup instead:

```
div.md-code-block
  div.bannerWrap                   ← hidden while a diagram is shown
    div[data-code-block-banner]    ← language label + copy
  div[data-code-block-content]
    pre                            ← the source (left in place, hidden by CSS)
    div.dsh-mermaid                ← the one node the plugin adds
```

The coupling is that markup. `tests/dom.test.mjs` drives a stand-in with the same
shape in a real browser, so a change to it fails loudly here instead of silently
drawing nothing.

## Why streaming needs care

DSH renders a live reply with an incremental Markdown renderer: every completed
block is parsed once and its React elements are cached, so only the growing tail
is re-rendered on each token. That gives one precise rule:

> never draw the tail; draw only a source that has stopped changing.

A block is drawn after its source has been unchanged for 220 ms. While tokens
flow the timer keeps resetting; when the fence closes and the next prose starts,
the block freezes, and the diagram appears mid-reply — no waiting for the turn to
end. A pause *inside* an open fence that lasts longer than 220 ms will draw
whatever has arrived; if the source then keeps growing, the panel is dropped and
redrawn, and a source Mermaid rejects leaves the code block exactly as it was.

Rendered diagrams are cached by source + theme, so a re-render (React rebuilding
the message, a theme switch) costs no Mermaid work.

## Where Mermaid comes from

The browser half asks the Host for `/api/mermaid.asset.js`; the Host serves the
`mermaid.min.js` from this package's own dependency tree over the same
authenticated, same-origin channel as the rest of the Web UI. The build is found
by Node's own resolution (`createRequire`), not by a fixed
`./node_modules/…` path: pnpm — which the Plugin Manager uses — keeps a
package's dependencies *beside* it, so a fixed path would 404 on every install
from Git while working perfectly in a linked checkout. It is a 3.4 MB
script, so it is fetched the first time a diagram is seen, not on every page
load, and revalidated with an ETag.

## Limits

- Diagrams are rendered in the browser only. A DSH client without the plugin (a
  phone on an old tab, `--no-client` tooling) shows the code block.
- Mermaid's `strict` security level is used: HTML labels are sanitized, and
  click-to-activate links are not available.
- A diagram Mermaid rejects is not decorated at all. The reason is logged to the
  browser console (`[mermaid] …`); there is no inline error row, because during
  streaming an incomplete diagram would flash one.
- No per-block history: the panel is a view of the file's Markdown, not a record.

## Install

Use DSH's own **Add plugin** dialog. No npm account, no publishing.

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| GitHub | `github:kjx-talesofai/dsh-plugin-mermaid#v0.2.1` |
| Local directory | an absolute path, e.g. `/path/to/dsh-plugin-mermaid` |

Restart the desktop app afterwards: the Host half owns the asset route and is
only loaded at startup. The browser half reloads with the page (`⌘R`).

This plugin is **not published to npm**, and `npm install` is not the install
path. Its one runtime dependency (the Mermaid build the Host serves) is installed
from the repository's `package.json`.

## Tests

```bash
npm ci
npm test           # 18: classifier, loader contract, patch/manifest consistency, the Host route, module resolution
npm run test:dom   # 33 in headless Chrome over CDP: `:has()`, real Mermaid output, the streaming sequence, both clipboard flavours
```

`test:dom` skips when no Chrome or Chromium is installed.

## Licence

MIT.

plugins.description: Per-project CodeGraph MCP tools for DeepSeek Harness: each session queries the repo it is actually working in
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-codegraph-project **让 DeepSeek Harness 的每个会话，只查它自己所在仓库的 CodeGraph 索引。** [![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-5ad1c4)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) [![CodeGraph](https://img.shields.io/badge/CodeGraph-1.6.2%20verified-f0a75a)](https://github.com/colbymchenry/codegraph) [![Tests](https://img.shields.io/badge/tests-27%20passing-6bc46d)](#验证) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue)](#license)
--- **这是一个 CodeGraph 兼容层，不是又一个 CodeGraph。** 插件不重新实现任何索引、查询或代码分析逻辑——它直接复用你已经安装的 CodeGraph CLI 和它建好的 `.codegraph/` 索引，把工具按**项目维度**接入 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)。因此： - CodeGraph 升级、换版本、重建索引，本插件照常工作； - Codex、Claude Code、Cursor 等工具的 CodeGraph 配置**原样保留**，互不影响——本插件不写任何全局配置文件，不抢注任何 MCP 服务名； - 卸载本插件，你的 CodeGraph 环境和你其他工具的集成完全不受影响。 接入后，DSH 里的每个会话根据自己的工作目录自动定位 `.codegraph/` 索引，多项目各用各的连接，互不串味。 ## 传统接法的问题：一个 cwd，多个仓库 把 CodeGraph 接进任何宿主（包括 DSH），官方姿势都是配一个 MCP 服务、指向一个项目目录。这在单仓库下没有问题，但 DSH 的插件配置是 **profile 级（全局）**——你只有一个配置位，却可能同时开着五六个仓库的会话： ```yaml - insert: - id: mcp-codegraph name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client" config: cwd: D:\path\to\only-one-project # ← 换个项目就错了 ``` 后果不是报错，而是更糟的**静默查错仓库**——你在仓库 B 的会话里提问，它返回仓库 A 的结果。会话看起来一切正常，答案却是另一个代码库的，直到某天你发现它引用了一个根本不存在的类。 本插件解决的问题就一句话：**让"当前项目"由会话自己决定，而不是由一份全局配置决定。** ## 解法：把"项目"补在 DSH 侧 ``` agent A（仓库甲的会话）── mcp__codegraph__codegraph_explore ──→ ProjectHub(甲) ──→ codegraph 进程 #1 agent B（仓库甲的会话）── mcp__codegraph__codegraph_explore ──→ （共享 #1） agent C（仓库乙的会话）── mcp__codegraph__codegraph_explore ──→ ProjectHub(乙) ──→ codegraph 进程 #2 agent D（无索引目录） ──（看不到任何 codegraph 工具） ``` 三条核心机制： 1. **工具注册在会话 scope 上** —— `agent.ctx.tools.register()`。无索引的会话根本看不到工具，不需要运行时拒绝。 2. **每个项目一个子进程** —— 进程 `cwd` 就是项目根，查询不需要额外参数；同项目的多个会话共享一个进程（引用计数，归零才关）。 3. **子进程走 `ctx.subprocess`** —— 由 DSH 托管，插件停用或 harness 退出时进程一定被回收。 挂载由一个会话级 `agent/pre-step` 监听器持续对齐，因此同时覆盖：会话中途 `codegraph init`（下一条消息即可用）、中途 `cd` 到另一个仓库（工具跟随切换）、索引被删除（工具消失）。 ## 安装 **前置条件** - DeepSeek Harness（`0.2.1-rc.2` 已验证） - [CodeGraph CLI](https://github.com/colbymchenry/codegraph) 已全局安装（`codegraph` 在 PATH 上，或配置 `codegraphBin`） - 目标项目执行过 `codegraph init` **两种安装方式** ```bash # 方式一：从 npm 安装（推荐，装完即用） dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add dsh-codegraph-project # 方式二：本地目录（开发/自用） # 在 DSH 的 Plugins 页粘贴本仓库的绝对路径，或用 CLI： dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add <本仓库路径> ``` > **两种方式的差异**：从 npm 安装时，依赖（`@deepseek-ai/schemastery`）随包自动 > 就位，无需任何额外步骤；本地目录安装时，由于 ESM 从源码目录解析依赖，需要先在 > 仓库里执行一次 `npm install --omit=dev`。 包已发布：[npmjs.com/package/dsh-codegraph-project](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-codegraph-project) · 当前版本见 `npm view dsh-codegraph-project version`。 安装后**零配置**：有索引的会话自动获得工具，没有的会话干净如初。 ## 配置 所有配置都有默认值，通常不需要动。在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里覆盖： ```yaml - id: codegraph-project config: serverName: codegraph # 工具命名空间 toolCallTimeoutMs: 60000 # 单次调用超时 watchIntervalMs: 2000 # 无索引会话的重探间隔 ``` | 字段 | 默认值 | 说明 | |---|---|---| | `enabled` | `true` | 总开关；`false` 时不注册工具、不起进程 | | `serverName` | `codegraph` | 公开工具名为 `mcp____` | | `codegraphBin` | `''` | 可执行文件绝对路径；留空从 PATH 探测 | | `codegraphArgs` | `['serve', '--mcp']` | 配合 `codegraphBin` 的参数 | | `toolCallTimeoutMs` | `60000` | 单次工具调用超时（必须为正数） | | `connectTimeoutMs` | `5000` | MCP 握手超时 | | `watchIntervalMs` | `2000` | 无索引会话的重新探测间隔，`0` 表示每条消息都探测 | **Windows 的 `.cmd` 坑**：npm 全局安装的 `codegraph` 是 `.cmd` 批处理，不能直接 spawn。插件会自动从 npm 全局布局推导 `node.exe` + 入口脚本；推导失败时错误信息里 给出可直接粘贴的 `codegraphBin` / `codegraphArgs` 配置。 ## 认领规则：什么时候一个目录算"项目" 会话目录向上逐层查找 `.codegraph/`，四条边界规则防止"静默服务错误仓库"： | 规则 | 原因 | |---|---| | `.codegraph/` 里必须有 `*.db` | 只有 `daemon.pid` / `daemon.log` 的目录不是项目 | | 遇到 `.git` 就停 | 索引在仓库边界之上属于别的仓库 | | 家目录 / 文件系统根不算 | 否则 `~/.codegraph/` 会让 `$HOME` 下所有会话认领它 | | `.codegraph` 读不了就停 | 继续向上会把权限问题变成查错仓库 | ## 验证 ```bash npm install --omit=dev # 先装依赖（见上） node --test test/locate.test.js test/pool.test.js test/bridge.test.js # 27 个单元测试 node scripts/check-locate.mjs # 认领规则 + 真机抽查 node scripts/check-sharing.mjs <有索引的项目目录> # 同项目共享一个进程 node scripts/check-failure-reporting.mjs # 启动失败的去重上报 node scripts/probe.mjs <有索引的项目目录> <查询词> # 真实 CodeGraph 端到端 node scripts/acceptance.mjs # 真机验收（headless） ``` 部分脚本接受环境变量指定本机测试项目： | 变量 | 用于 | 默认 | |---|---|---| | `CODEGRAPH_TEST_PROJECT` | `check-sharing.mjs`、`acceptance.mjs` | `.` | | `CODEGRAPH_TEST_PROJECTS` | `check-locate.mjs`（逗号分隔多个） | 跳过真机抽查 | | `DSH_BIN` | `acceptance.mjs`（dsh CLI 路径） | Windows 默认安装位置 | `acceptance.mjs` 会临时把插件与探针装进 `headless` profile、跑完自动还原；它验证 Host 内部可观察状态（会话可见工具、进程事实），不跑模型轮次。 ## 诊断 DSH 的 `SubprocessHandle` 不暴露 pid，插件改用**项目标识**对应进程与日志： - 每个 codegraph 子进程带环境变量 `DSH_CODEGRAPH_PROJECT=<项目根>`，按环境变量反查进程即可； - `ProjectHub.projectTag` / `ProjectHub.stderrTail` 暴露同一标识与子进程 stderr 尾部； - 会话销毁时按 debug 级记录释放结果与剩余会话数； - 启动失败在同一项目上只告警一次，恢复后复发会再次告警。 ## 更新 已通过 npm 安装后，升级到新版本： ```bash dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add dsh-codegraph-project # 重新 add 即升级到 latest ``` 维护者发布新版本： ```bash # 改代码 → 测试 → 提交（npm version 要求工作区干净） npm test git add -A && git commit -m "..." # 升版本号（同时改 package.json + 自动 commit + 打 tag） npm version patch # 修 bug：0.1.0 → 0.1.1 npm version minor # 新功能：0.1.0 → 0.2.0 npm version major # 破坏性变更：0.1.0 → 1.0.0 git push && git push --tags npm publish --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org ``` 版本号遵循 [semver](https://semver.org/lang/zh-CN/)：已发布的版本号永不复用，改动再小也发新版本号。 ## 文档 | 文档 | 内容 | |---|---| | [docs/implementation-plan.md](docs/implementation-plan.md) | 开发指南：架构、逐模块实现、实施顺序、验收清单 | | [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md) | 7 个关键设计决策与被否决的替代方案 | | [docs/technical-findings.md](docs/technical-findings.md) | 12 项 DSH 源码调研与运行时验证记录 | | [docs/risks.md](docs/risks.md) | 13 项风险与边界条件 | | [docs/why-no-prompt.md](docs/why-no-prompt.md) | 为什么不注入提示词 | ## 与 troytse/dsh-plugin-codegraph-project 的差异 参考过 [troytse/dsh-plugin-codegraph-project](https://github.com/troytse/dsh-plugin-codegraph-project)（MIT），设计取舍不同： | 能力 | 它 | 本插件 | |---|---|---| | CodeGraph 来源 | npx 拉取 + 版本管理 | 用系统已安装的 | | 工具注册 | 全局 + guard + 路由 | 按会话 scope | | 索引发现 | 250 行轮询 | `agent/pre-step` 懒检测 | | 提示词 | 注入 usage guidance | 不注入 | | 规模 | ~2900 行 | ~960 行 | ## License MIT

plugins.description: Native Rapid-MLX provider for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — dsh reads model facts from the server instead of your settings.yaml.
plugins.readme_text:
# @raullenchai/dsh-provider

A native [Rapid-MLX](https://github.com/raullenchai/Rapid-MLX) provider for
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) — so `dsh`
gets its model facts from the server instead of from whatever you typed into
`settings.yaml`.

[![CI](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

> **Status: published to npm** as
> [`@raullenchai/dsh-provider`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@raullenchai/dsh-provider).
> The end-to-end `dsh` run in [Verified](#verified) was on an M3 Ultra against
> `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`; `dsh 0.1.0-rc.8` is API-compatible — the `LlmAdapter`
> contract is byte-identical and the only changes are additive — and the
> adapter is re-verified against rc.8 at the protocol and unit-test level.
> DSH is still a developer preview that moves fast, so treat this as tracking
> a moving target, not a frozen compatibility promise.

## What it does for you

DSH can already talk to a local Rapid-MLX server through its generic
`openai-completions` provider. That route works — but it knows nothing about
your model beyond what you hand-wrote:

```yaml
# what the generic route makes you maintain, by hand, per model
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    rapid-mlx:
      baseURL: http://localhost:8000/v1
      defaultContextWindow: 262144      # you looked this up. is it still right?
      models:
        - id: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
          contextWindow: 262144
          reasoningEfforts: {off: none, low: low, medium: medium, high: high}
```

Rapid-MLX's `/v1/models` already publishes all of that and more. This adapter
reads it, so:

**1. Nothing to hand-write, and nothing to re-write when you switch models.**
Swap what `rapid-mlx serve` is running and `dsh` follows. No re-running setup,
no stale numbers.

**2. The reasoning control tells the truth.** Rapid-MLX reports whether a model
actually has a reasoning parser. A model that can't reason no longer shows an
off/low/medium/high selector that does nothing.

**3. Compaction is timed with the capacity that actually fits this Mac, not a
number that drifted.** This is the one that quietly costs you.
`dsh-compaction-basic` asks the provider for the route's capacity and compacts
at `thresholdRatio × capacity` (0.8 by default). The provider prefers the
server's **`max_model_len`** — Rapid-MLX's memory-fitted ceiling (what fits in
unified memory: weights + KV cache), in the vLLM/SGLang-standard field — over
the native `context_window`, and falls back to `context_window` on an older
server that doesn't report it. So compaction is timed to what the machine can
actually hold, not the model's advertised window (which it may not have room
for) and not a hand-written number copied from another model.

## Install

Needs Node ≥ 22.15 (dsh imports Node's Zstd stream API without declaring it)
and a running Rapid-MLX server.

```sh
# From npm:
dsh plugin --profile web add @raullenchai/dsh-provider

# …or straight from source — the package ships plain JS with no build step:
dsh plugin --profile web add github:raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider

export RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8000/v1     # optional; this is the default
dsh web
```

Then point the agent at the route:

```yaml
# $DSH_HOME/settings.yaml
agent-default-model:
  provider: rapid-mlx
  model: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
```

Verified: that command installs and activates as a profile layer against
`dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`. To hack on it locally instead, see
[Local development](#local-development).

## Model management (v0.2.0)

Beyond the provider route, the plugin registers five tools and a `/rapid-mlx`
command so the agent can see and manage models without leaving the session.
The split follows which surface actually owns each fact: served-model facts
come from the structured HTTP `/v1/models`; the download cache and pull/remove
are CLI-only, so those — and only those — shell out to `rapid-mlx` through the
harness subprocess seam.

| Tool | Source | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `rapid_mlx_serving` | HTTP `/v1/models` | The model(s) served right now, deduped, with context window, reasoning/tool parsers, MoE/hybrid, and modalities. |
| `rapid_mlx_cached` | `rapid-mlx models --cached` | Downloaded models and their on-disk size. |
| `rapid_mlx_pull` | `rapid-mlx pull <name>` | Download a model (alias or HF repo id). Cancellable; no fixed deadline. |
| `rapid_mlx_remove` | `rapid-mlx rm -y <name>` | Delete a cached model to free disk. |
| `rapid_mlx_health` | HTTP + `rapid-mlx --version` | API up? CLI reachable? Reported as two independent facts. |

`/rapid-mlx` prints a one-shot overview: health, the served model and its facts,
and total cache disk usage.

The CLI is resolved from the `cliCommand` config (default `rapid-mlx` on
`PATH`, or `$RAPID_MLX_CLI`); set it to an absolute path if the binary is not on
the harness's `PATH`. `rapid_mlx_pull`/`rapid_mlx_remove` are the only tools
that change anything on disk, and they run non-interactively (`rm` is forced
with `-y` because the subprocess seam ignores stdin).

## Verified

Against `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7` on an M3 Ultra:

- Installs and **activates as a profile layer** (no "declares no `dsh.bundle`"
  warning; the entry shows up in `dsh --profile headless --dump-config`).
- Registers the `rapid-mlx` route with `ctx.llm` and serves real queries.
- Plain chat, a single tool call, and the multi-step bug-fix task that gates
  Rapid-MLX releases — the last one fixed the bug and made the target repo's own
  test pass, verified independently, in 36 s on `qwen3.6-35b-8bit`.

## Not done yet

Being explicit, because the point of the adapter is to *use* what the server
says and some of it is still only read:

- `recommended_sampling` — should be applied automatically per model.
- `tool_call_parser` — should let `dsh` fail fast on a model that cannot emit
  `tool_calls`, instead of looping.
- `is_hybrid` / `is_moe` / `capabilities` — read, not yet acted on.
- **Memory-aware capacity.** Today `resolveModel()` reports the model's
  *advertised* context window. On a Mac the real ceiling is unified memory, and
  reporting that instead is the biggest remaining win — it needs Rapid-MLX to
  expose a usable-capacity figure first.
- Images are not carried through `stream()` — but they now **refuse** with
  `LlmError(..., 'UNSUPPORTED')` rather than being dropped, per the cookbook.
  Text, reasoning and tool calls are carried.
- The route is registered as `rapid-mlx`. If your `settings.yaml` also declares
  a `rapid-mlx` provider under `llm-pi-ai`, the two compete for one route name
  (`registerAdapter` owns provider exclusivity). Use one or rename ours.

## Conformance with the official adapter contract

Built against
[`docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/main/docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md)
and its "protocol obligations" section. Each item has a test:

| Obligation | How it is met |
|---|---|
| `usage` before `finish`, nothing after `finish` | usage is buffered and flushed at end-of-stream, so a trailing usage-only chunk cannot reorder it |
| Tool-call `arguments` are raw JSON strings end to end | fragments stream as `argumentsDelta` and reassemble unparsed |
| Block indexes in first-seen order, reused per block | verified across a reasoning-then-text response |
| Errors take exactly two sanctioned paths | transport/protocol failures **throw** `LlmError` with a stable code; nothing ends the stream quietly |
| Honor `options.signal` | passed to `fetch` and to the SSE reader; an `AbortError` is re-thrown unchanged, not reclassified |
| A field the provider cannot honor throws `UNSUPPORTED` | image content refuses instead of being narrowed away |
| Config is a schemastery schema with env fallback | `export const Config`, fed from `cordis.patch.yml` via `!!js process.env.RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL` |

`finish.replayState` is not emitted: Rapid-MLX needs no native response ids
or signatures on follow-up calls, so there is nothing lossless to project.

## Three things worth knowing before you edit this

Each of these cost real

plugins.description: A portable memory protocol for AI agents — load it as standing rules; a curation discipline + reference spec + optional cap hook.
plugins.readme_text:
**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

# Engramory

[![CI](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Python 3.9+](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.9%2B-blue.svg)](https://www.python.org/)

**An opinionated, zero-infrastructure memory *protocol* for small-scale, local,
file-based agent memory** — a strict curation discipline plus a validator
(`tools/engramory_doctor.py`), loaded as **standing rules** (`CLAUDE.md` /
`AGENTS.md` / your host's rules file). It is not a database, a framework, or a
relevance-loaded skill. Memory is a folder of small, human-readable markdown files
plus one always-loaded index. No database, no embeddings, no server — just
plain-text files you can open, read, edit, and diff in any editor (the live store
itself stays git-ignored).

> *Engramory* — coined from *engram* (the physical trace a memory leaves in the
> brain) + *memory*. Here: one file = one fact.

> ⚠️ **Unrelated projects share this name.** *engram + memory* is an obvious
> coinage and at least one other repository arrived at it independently. This
> project is only ever `tinqiao-oss/engramory` (npm: `dsh-engramory`); a same-named
> repo under a different owner is not a fork, a mirror, or a newer version of it.

> 🤖 **Are you an AI agent, asked to install or check this?** Start at
> **[AGENT-SETUP.md](AGENT-SETUP.md)**, not at the install steps below. It is the
> procedure for working out what your host can actually enforce, whether a store
> already exists, what you must not touch, and what to tell the user — the parts
> agents reliably get wrong when improvising.

> **Status: 0.12.1 — experimental.** The hard index cap (a `PreToolUse` hook) is
> deterministic for the matched direct-edit tools (`Edit | Write | MultiEdit`) but
> NOT a global write guard (shell tools — Bash, PowerShell, a background Monitor
> command — plus MCP file tools, external editors, and sync clients bypass it);
> the discipline loads as standing rules the model follows, so it's
> best-effort, not guaranteed on every task (see [SKILL.md](SKILL.md) §8). Assumes a
> single writer / serialized writes. Don't rely on it as a "mandatory, reliable,
> cross-agent" memory layer yet.

---

## What this is — and is NOT

Engramory is **not a new memory architecture**. The "markdown files + a small index
loaded into context + the model curates it" pattern is now the mainstream shape
for agent memory, and it ships in several places already. Engramory stands on:

- **Claude Code native auto-memory** — the same markdown-`MEMORY.md`-index +
  lazy detail-file pattern; its system prompt even uses the same
  `user | feedback | project | reference` type vocabulary (per
  [anthropics/claude-code#58840](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/58840);
  the *public docs* describe only the index + topic files). Engramory is a
  disciplined superset of this default.
- **[basic-memory](https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory)** — markdown
  source-of-truth, YAML frontmatter `type`, `[[wikilink]]` graph, local-first.
- **[obsidian-second-brain](https://github.com/eugeniughelbur/obsidian-second-brain)**,
  **[claude-memory-compiler](https://github.com/coleam00/claude-memory-compiler)**
  ("a loaded index beats vector search at personal scale"), and the broader family
  of markdown-memory skills.

What Engramory contributes is the **opinionated bundle + the discipline**, not the
primitives. Do not claim novelty on markdown, frontmatter, wikilinks, a loaded
index, one-file-per-fact notes, or curation hygiene — all are prior art.

## What's actually differentiated

1. **A role/purpose ontology, headed by `feedback` = procedural memory.** The
   semantic / episodic / **procedural** split is established prior art — the CoALA
   taxonomy, and a named procedural type in LangMem and mem0 — so Engramory does not
   claim the category. What it does is make procedural `feedback` the *spine* of a
   deliberately tiny, hand-authored, human-readable set, with required **Why:** /
   **How to apply:** lines, instead of auto-extracting it into a vector/graph store.
   The contribution is the packaging and discipline, not the ontology.

2. **The curation contract as concrete behaviour** the protocol applies (model-followed, not a hard gate): dedup-before-write,
   update-don't-duplicate, delete-when-wrong, and a negative-scope rule ("don't
   store what git/CLAUDE.md/the code already records"). Surveys consistently name
   *modify/delete/forget* as the most under-implemented memory operation — Engramory
   makes it the spine.

3. **A bounded index designed not to silently rot.** The index loads every session and
   Claude Code reads the first 200 lines / 25 KB (documented behavior), so an unbounded index silently
   drops memories off the end. Engramory warns at 150 lines / 20 KB, compacts-or-asks
   before 200 / 25 KB, and ships a hard `PreToolUse` hook backstop (it blocks only
   *growth* past the cap — shrinking/compaction edits always pass). Both the line and
   byte caps apply — whichever is hit first triggers (an index can be under the line
   count yet over on bytes when the lines run long).

   Claude Code has since followed up on this natively: v2.1.186 (released
   2026-06-22) reminds the agent to compact the index when it nears the cap, and
   v2.1.210 (released 2026-07-14) turned an over-cap write into an explicit error
   instead of a silent truncation. Both are after-the-fact alerts, though — the
   write still lands, and entries past the cap stay invisible until someone
   compacts. Engramory's hook denies the write *before* it happens, so a write
   through the matched edit tools never leaves the index over-cap in the first
   place (writes outside them — a shell, an MCP file tool — are not gated; see the
   status note above and SKILL.md §8). The native alerts validate the direction
   and make a welcome second layer — and older versions and other hosts still
   have neither.

## How it compares

| | storage | recall | human-readable | typed ontology | curation discipline | bounded index | infra |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Engramory** | md files | loaded index → open file | ✅ | ✅ role-based (4) | ✅ contract (model-run) | ✅ 150/200 + hook | none |
| CC auto-memory | md files | loaded index → open file | ✅ | ✅ same 4 types | partial (auto) | ~200-line window* | none (built-in) |
| basic-memory | md + SQLite | semantic/FTS search | ✅ | ✅ freeform type | schema + overwrite checks | ❌ (no loaded index) | SQLite + embeddings |
| obsidian-second-brain | md vault | index-first + search | ✅ | folder-typed | ✅ reconcile/lint | partial | none |
| mem0 / Zep | vector/graph DB | semantic | ❌ (DB) | typed (prefs/episodic/proc.; Zep custom) | auto-extract | n/a | DB + embeddings |

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-codex-memories

Codex-style **long-term memory** for DSH: cross-session memory that ingests finished sessions, consolidates them into a searchable handbook, and injects a compact summary before every turn.

It reproduces the two-stage structure of the Codex memory system rather than approximating it: per-session extraction first, then a consolidation pass over many raw memories.

## Why

DSH sessions are isolated by default. A correction you made yesterday, a command that only works in one repo, a symptom/cause/fix you already paid for — none of it carries over unless you restate it. This plugin makes the agent remember:

- how you want it to work, without being told twice
- where the truth lives in a specific repo, and which commands actually run
- which failure has which fix

## How it works

```
session goes idle for N seconds
   └─ Stage 1  one model call per session -> session_summaries/<slug>.md + raw_memories.md
        └─ Stage 2  once enough memory accumulates -> MEMORY.md + memory_summary.md
             └─ before each turn, memory_summary.md is injected into the prompt
```

All durable artifacts are plain Markdown you can read, edit, version, or move. `index.json` holds the extraction cache, job records, and the consolidation watermark.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @lushdawn/dsh-codex-memories
```

Local development:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add link:<absolute path to this directory>
```

Restart DSH, or let a live profile hot-load it.

## Commands

| Command | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| `/memory status` | memory root, extracted sessions, pending consolidation, last timestamps |
| `/memory show` | print the current `memory_summary.md` |
| `/memory extract` | extract the current session immediately |
| `/memory backfill` | scan stored sessions and extract the ones never processed |
| `/memory consolidate` | merge pending memory into `MEMORY.md` now |
| `/memory forget <sessionId\|all>` | drop extraction records (handbook content is kept) |
| `/memory on` / `off` | toggle automatic extraction for this process |

## Tools

Exposed to the model when `dedicatedTools` is on:

| Tool | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| `memory_search` | line-level keyword search across memory files (`any` / `all` / `on_same_line`) |
| `memory_read` | read one memory file by line range |
| `memory_list` | inventory of the memory folder and pending work |
| `memory_note` | append one ad-hoc note — the only write path the model is offered |

The model is instructed to cite memory as `MEMORY.md:12-14|note=[...]`.

## Configuration

Every field has a safe default; override in your profile patch:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-codex-memories
      name: dsh-codex-memories
      config:
        storageDir: ''            # default $DSH_HOME/memories
        generate: true
        use: true
        dedicatedTools: true
        model: ''                 # e.g. deepseek-official/deepseek-flash
        extractModel: ''          # falls back to model
        consolidationModel: ''    # falls back to model
        idleSeconds: 120
        maxSessionsPerRun: 3
        maxSessionAgeDays: 30
        consolidationThreshold: 2
        maxInjectChars: 9000
        minSessionMessages: 4
        extractMaxTokens: 8000
        consolidateMaxTokens: 16000
```

When `model` is empty the plugin reads the current default model, then falls back to `deepseek-official/deepseek-flash`.

## Data layout

```
$DSH_HOME/memories/
├── MEMORY.md                    # durable handbook, Task Group organized
├── memory_summary.md            # prompt-loaded layer; first line must be v1
├── raw_memories.md              # mechanical stage-1 merge, ascending session id
├── session_summaries/<slug>.md  # one structured recap per session
├── extensions/ad_hoc/notes/     # notes written by you or the model
└── index.json                   # extraction cache, job records, watermark
```

## Cost and privacy

- **It spends tokens**: one Stage-1 call per session and one Stage-2 call per consolidation. Sessions under 4 messages are skipped; at most 3 sessions are processed per sweep.
- **Local files only**: no network access beyond the model API it calls.
- **It enters your prompt**: `memory_summary.md` is injected every turn, which is why it is capped by `maxInjectChars`.
- **Auditable**: every artifact is readable Markdown.
- **The model cannot rewrite the handbook**: it may only append ad-hoc notes; consolidation is a separate pass, so one turn cannot corrupt durable memory.

## Fidelity to Codex

The behavioral spec comes from reverse engineering Codex itself — the on-disk shape under `~/.codex/memories` plus the prompt templates embedded in `codex.exe`:

| Codex | dsh-codex-memories |
| --- | --- |
| `~/.codex/memories/` | `$DSH_HOME/memories/` |
| `MEMORY.md` / `memory_summary.md` / `raw_memories.md` | same names, same formats |
| `rollout_summaries/*.md` | `session_summaries/*.md` |
| `memories_1.sqlite` | `index.json` |
| Stage 1 extraction prompt | `PHASE1_TEMPLATE` in `lib/prompts.js` |
| Phase 2 consolidation prompt | `PHASE2_TEMPLATE` in `lib/prompts.js` |
| usage guidance + citation format | `USAGE_TEMPLATE` in `lib/prompts.js` |
| rollout scan backfill | `/memory backfill` + boot sweep |

See [docs/mechanism.md](docs/mechanism.md) for the full mechanism and the evidence behind it.

## Known limits

- Stage 2 asks for two complete documents in one reply. On a very large handbook the reply can hit the output cap; the old files are then kept and the pass reports an error instead of writing something corrupt.
- Automatic extraction needs the process alive during the idle window; otherwise the next boot's `backfill` catches up.
- Retrieval is keyword/line based, not semantic — the same tradeoff Codex makes. Route with `keywords` in `MEMORY.md`.

## Contributing

Issues and pull requests are welcome — see [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). For anything
security-related, follow [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) instead of opening a public issue. Release
history lives in [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md).

## License

MIT

# Engramory

[![CI](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Python 3.9+](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.9%2B-blue.svg)](https://www.python.org/)

**An opinionated, zero-infrastructure memory *protocol* for small-scale, local,
file-based agent memory** — a strict curation discipline plus a validator
(`tools/engramory_doctor.py`), loaded as **standing rules** (`CLAUDE.md` /
`AGENTS.md` / your host's rules file). It is not a database, a framework, or a
relevance-loaded skill. Memory is a folder of small, human-readable markdown files
plus one always-loaded index. No database, no embeddings, no server — just
plain-text files you can open, read, edit, and diff in any editor (the live store
itself stays git-ignored).

> *Engramory* — coined from *engram* (the physical trace a memory leaves in the
> brain) + *memory*. Here: one file = one fact.

> ⚠️ **Unrelated projects share this name.** *engram + memory* is an obvious
> coinage and at least one other repository arrived at it independently. This
> project is only ever `tinqiao-oss/engramory` (npm: `dsh-engramory`); a same-named
> repo under a different owner is not a fork, a mirror, or a newer version of it.

> 🤖 **Are you an AI agent, asked to install or check this?** Start at
> **[AGENT-SETUP.md](AGENT-SETUP.md)**, not at the install steps below. It is the
> procedure for working out what your host can actually enforce, whether a store
> already exists, what you must not touch, and what to tell the user — the parts
> agents reliably get wrong when improvising.

> **Status: 0.12.1 — experimental.** The hard index cap (a `PreToolUse` hook) is
> deterministic for the matched direct-edit tools (`Edit | Write | MultiEdit`) but
> NOT a global write guard (shell tools — Bash, PowerShell, a background Monitor
> command — plus MCP file tools, external editors, and sync clients bypass it);
> the discipline loads as standing rules the model follows, so it's
> best-effort, not guaranteed on every task (see [SKILL.md](SKILL.md) §8). Assumes a
> single writer / serialized writes. Don't rely on it as a "mandatory, reliable,
> cross-agent" memory layer yet.

---

## What this is — and is NOT

Engramory is **not a new memory architecture**. The "markdown files + a small index
loaded into context + the model curates it" pattern is now the mainstream shape
for agent memory, and it ships in several places already. Engramory stands on:

- **Claude Code native auto-memory** — the same markdown-`MEMORY.md`-index +
  lazy detail-file pattern; its system prompt even uses the same
  `user | feedback | project | reference` type vocabulary (per
  [anthropics/claude-code#58840](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/58840);
  the *public docs* describe only the index + topic files). Engramory is a
  disciplined superset of this default.
- **[basic-memory](https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory)** — markdown
  source-of-truth, YAML frontmatter `type`, `[[wikilink]]` graph, local-first.
- **[obsidian-second-brain](https://github.com/eugeniughelbur/obsidian-second-brain)**,
  **[claude-memory-compiler](https://github.com/coleam00/claude-memory-compiler)**
  ("a loaded index beats vector search at personal scale"), and the broader family
  of markdown-memory skills.

What Engramory contributes is the **opinionated bundle + the discipline**, not the
primitives. Do not claim novelty on markdown, frontmatter, wikilinks, a loaded
index, one-file-per-fact notes, or curation hygiene — all are prior art.

## What's actually differentiated

1. **A role/purpose ontology, headed by `feedback` = procedural memory.** The
   semantic / episodic / **procedural** split is established prior art — the CoALA
   taxonomy, and a named procedural type in LangMem and mem0 — so Engramory does not
   claim the category. What it does is make procedural `feedback` the *spine* of a
   deliberately tiny, hand-authored, human-readable set, with required **Why:** /
   **How to apply:** lines, instead of auto-extracting it into a vector/graph store.
   The contribution is the packaging and discipline, not the ontology.

2. **The curation contract as concrete behaviour** the protocol applies (model-followed, not a hard gate): dedup-before-write,
   update-don't-duplicate, delete-when-wrong, and a negative-scope rule ("don't
   store what git/CLAUDE.md/the code already records"). Surveys consistently name
   *modify/delete/forget* as the most under-implemented memory operation — Engramory
   makes it the spine.

3. **A bounded index designed not to silently rot.** The index loads every session and
   Claude Code reads the first 200 lines / 25 KB (documented behavior), so an unbounded index silently
   drops memories off the end. Engramory warns at 150 lines / 20 KB, compacts-or-asks
   before 200 / 25 KB, and ships a hard `PreToolUse` hook backstop (it blocks only
   *growth* past the cap — shrinking/compaction edits always pass). Both the line and
   byte caps apply — whichever is hit first triggers (an index can be under the line
   count yet over on bytes when the lines run long).

   Claude Code has since followed up on this natively: v2.1.186 (released
   2026-06-22) reminds the agent to compact the index when it nears the cap, and
   v2.1.210 (released 2026-07-14) turned an over-cap write into an explicit error
   instead of a silent truncation. Both are after-the-fact alerts, though — the
   write still lands, and entries past the cap stay invisible until someone
   compacts. Engramory's hook denies the write *before* it happens, so a write
   through the matched edit tools never leaves the index over-cap in the first
   place (writes outside them — a shell, an MCP file tool — are not gated; see the
   status note above and SKILL.md §8). The native alerts validate the direction
   and make a welcome second layer — and older versions and other hosts still
   have neither.

## How it compares

| | storage | recall | human-readable | typed ontology | curation discipline | bounded index | infra |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Engramory** | md files | loaded index → open file | ✅ | ✅ role-based (4) | ✅ contract (model-run) | ✅ 150/200 + hook | none |
| CC auto-memory | md files | loaded index → open file | ✅ | ✅ same 4 types | partial (auto) | ~200-line window* | none (built-in) |
| basic-memory | md + SQLite | semantic/FTS search | ✅ | ✅ freeform type | schema + overwrite checks | ❌ (no loaded index) | SQLite + embeddings |
| obsidian-second-brain | md vault | index-first + search | ✅ | folder-typed | ✅ reconcile/lint | partial | none |
| mem0 / Zep | vector/graph DB | semantic | ❌ (DB) | typed (prefs/episodic/proc.; Zep custom) | auto-extract | n/a | DB + embeddings |
| [agentmemory](https://github.com/rohitg00/agentmemory) | SQLite + vector index (+opt. graph) | hybrid BM25+vector (+opt. graph), RRF | ❌ (DB/engine) | ✅ 4-tier lifecycle (work./epis./sem./proc.) | auto (capture + dedup + decay) | n/a | iii engine (local) + opt. embeddings |

Engramory's lane: **minimalism + actionable role typing + curation discipline, zero
infra.** It does *not* try to out-search basic-memory, out-scale mem0, or
out-capture agentmemory — those solve a different problem (auto-capture /
auto-ingest at volume) at a different cost point. agentmemory is the closest
heavyweight foil: also local-first, but it bets on automatic capture (lifecycle
hooks) + hybrid retrieval (BM25 + vectors + optional graph) on a SQLite/`iii`
engine, where Engramory bets on hand-curation + a tiny always-loaded index and
ships no engine at all.

\* Claude Code's [memory docs](https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/claude-code/memory)
document this exactly: *"the first 200 lines of `MEMORY.md`, or the first 25KB,
whichever comes first, are loaded at the start of every conversation."* Other hosts
vary, so the window stays configurable via the hook's env vars.

## Where it fits — and the goal

Engramory is a **portable memory *discipline*, not a

plugins.readme_text:
flameox

Bounded local runtime evidence for coding agents.

Flameox coordinates profilers, benchmark tools, trace processors, and direct local targets. It turns an explicit artifact or command into bounded evidence while keeping durable preservation optional. The agent chooses hypotheses and experiments; Flameox records observed inputs, execution provenance, typed evidence, coverage, and limitations. There is no workspace to initialize or project configuration to maintain. Pass exact artifact paths to analysis and an explicit argv plus absolute working directory to capture. Flameox does not search parent directories, edit project files, or provide a hosted service. ## Quick start Configure an MCP client with the global setup command: ```console npx flameox@latest setup ``` Setup detects supported clients and asks which configurations to update. For automation, select clients explicitly, for example `--client codex --yes` or `--all --yes`; `--dry-run` reports the paths and actions without writing. Setup preserves unrelated client configuration and does not change project files. See [the npm package guide](npm/README.md) for details. Update existing MCP registrations with: ```console npx flameox@latest update ``` `update --check` reports available updates without changing configuration. Updates preserve each client's provider extras and settings, verify the new environment before changing release pins, and report which clients need a restart or reconnect. Use `--client codex` to select one client, or `--version 0.2.8` to select a specific release, including for rollback. The Python CLI exposes the same `flameox update` command. For direct CLI use, pass exact artifact paths or an explicit command: ```console uvx flameox analyze preview_artifact /absolute/path/to/artifact.json uvx flameox capture --provider direct --cwd "$PWD" -- python benchmark.py ``` To launch the stdio MCP server manually: ```console uvx flameox mcp serve ``` For local development, clone the repository, install its development dependencies, and inspect the available tools: ```console git clone https://github.com/morluto/flameox.git cd flameox uv sync --extra dev --extra memory --extra trace --extra cpu uv run flameox mcp inspect ``` ## Evidence and storage Analysis and unpreserved capture use bounded session scratch. Session `analysis_id` values expire when evicted or when the server stops. Explicit preservation creates the user-level Flameox data directory and stores native bytes and a canonical evidence bundle by SHA-256. Set `FLAMEOX_DATA_DIR` to choose another location. Preservation is optional; it does not imply full console-output retention. Flameox distinguishes observed, derived, and inferred claims. Profiles guide exploration but do not establish causality or performance improvement. Confirmatory claims require representative workloads, declared metrics and estimands, compatible identities, preserved samples, and a semantic oracle. ## MCP The MCP server has no workspace binding. It exposes named analysis and capture tools through the same operation registry as the CLI. Analysis tools accept explicit sources; capture tools accept a typed target and provider. Tool schemas expose operation-specific fields directly. Inspect the catalog with `flameox mcp inspect`; use `--tool TOOL_NAME` for focused schemas and examples. The complete contract and current tool catalog are in [the interface guide](docs/interfaces.md). Tools return their full bounded results inline, including failures and recovery actions. Preserved evidence has a durable `evidence_id`; `inspect_evidence` returns its redacted metadata and replay sources inline. Capture takes argv, not a shell string. A direct target supplies an absolute working directory and bounded environment overrides. Results may include `next_page`; replay its named analysis tool and arguments unchanged. Capture continuations read collected artifacts and do not rerun the target. MCP work belongs to the live request, so cancellation applies directly and no detached job survives a restart. ## Documentation - [Architecture](docs/architecture.md) describes process and package boundaries. - [Storage and evidence](docs/storage-and-evidence.md) defines preservation and provenance. - [Investigations](docs/investigations.md) covers experiments, comparison, and evidence quality. - [Adapters](docs/adapters.md) documents provider compatibility and integration policy. - [Runtime safety](docs/runtime-safety.md) covers limits, recovery, integrity, and privacy. - [Interfaces](docs/interfaces.md) defines CLI and MCP contracts. - [Testing](docs/testing.md) describes test selections and known proof gaps. ## Development Flameox requires Python 3.12 or newer and uses the committed `uv.lock`. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for development setup and contribution guidance. ```console uv run ruff check src tests tools uv run ruff format --check src tests tools uv run mypy src tests tools uv run pytest -q ``` Flameox is licensed under the MIT License.

plugins.description: DSH Desktop plugin: hold Ctrl and tap Tab to switch between recently viewed sessions; release the modifier to open the highlighted one. Ctrl+Shift+Tab cycles backwards.
plugins.readme_text:
# Session Switcher

English overview below · 完整详细文档为简体中文，见 [中文说明](#中文说明)

Session Switcher (`dsh-session-switcher`) is a plugin for **DSH Desktop** that brings hold-to-switch navigation to your recently viewed sessions. Hold `Ctrl` and tap `Tab` to open a floating list of recent sessions with the next target highlighted; tap `Tab` again to move down, then release the modifier(s) to open the highlighted session (`Ctrl+Shift+Tab` moves backwards and `Esc` cancels). The highlight moves while the modifier is held, so you can skip past sessions before committing on release. It is built for DSH Desktop: in a browser tab `Ctrl+Tab` belongs to the browser, so the plugin won't fire there.

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Hold `Ctrl`, tap `Tab` | Open the list and highlight the next recently viewed session; tap again to move down |
| `Ctrl` + `Shift` + `Tab` | Move the highlight backwards |
| Release the modifier(s) | Open the highlighted session and close the list |
| `Esc` | Cancel without switching |
| `Enter` / click a row | Open that session immediately |
| `↑` / `↓` | Move the highlight while the list is open |
| Click outside / window blur | Cancel |

## 安装 / Installation

### 从插件管理器安装（推荐）/ Install from the plugin manager

The plugin is a normal DSH bundle, so DSH's own plugin manager can install and enable it:

1. Open the **Plugins** page in DSH (the plugin manager page in the sidebar; 中文界面为「插件」).
2. Select **Add plugin** → **Install a third-party plugin**（「添加插件」→「安装第三方插件」）.
3. Enter the repository address and select **Install**:

   ```text
   https://github.com/Yporcupine/dsh-session-switcher
   ```

4. If DSH asks for a restart, restart DSH Desktop. The installer adds the dependency to your profile and enables the bundle for you; no manual configuration is needed.

To disable or uninstall the plugin later, use the same **Plugins** page.

### 命令行安装 / Install with the CLI

The same installation is available from the `dsh` CLI:

```bash
dsh plugin add https://github.com/Yporcupine/dsh-session-switcher
```

Use `--profile <name>` to target a specific profile (for example `dsh plugin --profile desktop add ...`). The CLI may ask you to restart DSH afterwards. You can also install the release tarball — paste the download link of the `dsh-session-switcher-1.3.0.tgz` asset from the [Releases page](https://github.com/Yporcupine/dsh-session-switcher/releases) into the same dialog or command.

### 本地开发安装 / Local checkout (development)

To hack on the plugin, run a checkout as a linked bundle. Prefer DSH's own installer — it writes the `link:` dependency **and** runs the profile's package install, so the checkout is linked into the profile; editing the manifest by hand alone skips that step and the bundle is skipped at startup.

1. Clone the repository into your DSH bundles directory (`~/.dsh/bundles/`; Windows: `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\bundles\`):

   ```bash
   # macOS / Linux
   git clone https://github.com/Yporcupine/dsh-session-switcher.git ~/.dsh/bundles/session-switcher
   ```

   ```powershell
   # Windows (PowerShell)
   git clone https://github.com/Yporcupine/dsh-session-switcher.git "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\bundles\session-switcher"
   ```

2. Install the checkout through the same add-plugin flow, pointing it at the local directory: **Plugins** page → **Add plugin** → **Install a third-party plugin** → enter the absolute path of the checkout (`/home/<you>/.dsh/bundles/session-switcher`, `/Users/<you>/.dsh/bundles/session-switcher`, or `C:/Users/<you>/.dsh/bundles/session-switcher`). Or use the CLI:

   ```bash
   dsh plugin --profile desktop add /home/<you>/.dsh/bundles/session-switcher
   ```

   DSH records a `link:` dependency, installs it into the profile, and enables the bundle.

3. Restart DSH Desktop. After later edits to the checkout, restart DSH Desktop (or disable and re-enable the bundle on the **Plugins** page) to remount the client module.

#### 手动回退 / Fallback: edit the profile manifest by hand

Only if the installer cannot be used. Edit the DSH Desktop profile manifest, `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json` (Windows: `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\package.json`), to add the dependency and the bundle selection:

```json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-session-switcher": "link:/home/<you>/.dsh/bundles/session-switcher"
  },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": ["...", "dsh-session-switcher"]
    }
  }
}
```

Use the absolute path of your clone: `/home/<you>/...` on Linux, `/Users/<you>/...` on macOS, `C:/Users/<you>/...` on Windows (JSON paths use forward slashes on every OS); from the profile directory the relative form `link:../../bundles/session-switcher` resolves to the same location. Then relink and reinstall the profile — without this the linked package never reaches `node_modules` and the bundle is skipped:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop install
```

Restart DSH Desktop afterwards.

> **浏览器 / Browser:** the shortcuts target DSH Desktop. In a browser tab `Ctrl+Tab` belongs to the browser, so the plugin won't fire there.

## 中文说明

DSH Desktop 插件：按住 `Ctrl` 敲 `Tab`，弹出「最近会话」浮动小窗，高亮待切换的会话；
**松开修饰键即打开高亮会话**并收起小窗。

| 操作 | 效果 |
| --- | --- |
| `Ctrl+Tab`（按住 Ctrl 连按 Tab） | 打开浮动窗，高亮「下一个最近查看的会话」；继续按 Tab 依次下移 |
| `Ctrl+Shift+Tab` | 反向移动高亮 |
| 松开修饰键 | 打开高亮会话，关闭小窗 |
| `Esc` | 取消，不切换 |
| `Enter` / 鼠标点击某一行 | 立即打开该会话 |
| `↑` / `↓` | 移动高亮（小窗打开时） |
| 点击小窗外 / 窗口失焦 | 取消 |

- 插件按 DSH Desktop 设计：浏览器里 `Ctrl+Tab` 归浏览器所有，插件不会被触发。
- macOS 同样使用 `Ctrl+Tab` / `Ctrl+Shift+Tab`（`Cmd+Tab` 是系统应用切换，应用收不到）。

### 实现要点：为什么用 fixed 输入而不是可编辑快捷键

DSH Desktop 的**原生键盘桥**会先于页面拦截「可编辑快捷键」的按键组合，然后 Electron
会吞掉随后的**修饰键 keyup**（DSH 官方 shortcuts 文档的 “Understand the implementation” 一节
也说明：Electron 在原生拦截之后可能省略 keyup）。一旦 `Ctrl` 的 keyup 到不了页面，浮动窗就无法知道「Ctrl 已松开」，
只能等下一次按键——这正是早期版本「松开 Ctrl 无反应、要再按一次 Ctrl 才切换」的根因
（已用合成按键 + UI Automation 实测复现：`Ctrl+Tab`、`Ctrl+B` 等任何可编辑快捷键之后
都收不到 `keyup`）。

因此 `Ctrl+Tab` / `Ctrl+Shift+Tab` 注册为 **fixed 输入动作**（`ctx.shortcuts.registerFixed`
+ `ctx.shortcuts.observeFixedInput`）：fixed 动作不走原生桥拦截，留在正常的 DOM 输入路径，
修饰键 keyup 可以正常收到，于是「松手提交」可靠。代价是这两行在
**Settings → Keyboard shortcuts**（`Mod+/`）里显示为只读条目（Application 分组，键帽
`Ctrl + Tab` / `Ctrl + Shift + Tab`），不能改键；不想要时停用/卸载插件即可。

#### 为什么点击行曾「只关窗、不切换」（已修复）

DSH 的 shortcuts 服务在**每个 `pointerdown`** 上都会给 fixed 输入观察者发一次
`{ type: "reset" }`（用于中断多键序列）。早期版本把 reset 一律当作取消：鼠标按下瞬间
小窗就被卸载，行的 React `click` 永远来不及触发——于是「点一下小窗消失，但会话没切换」。
现在的做法是：在 **window 捕获阶段**（早于 shortcuts 服务的 document 捕获 reset）先判断
这次按下是否落在小窗内；**落在窗内的按下不算取消**，只吞掉紧接着的 reset，让行正常收到
click 并切换；点到窗外仍然立即取消。松开指针（`pointerup`/`pointercancel`）后恢复常规
reset 行为。

### 参考实现

当前 ChatGPT / Codex 桌面端（2026，版本 26）把 `Ctrl+Tab` 定义为 **“Next recently viewed chat”**，
`Ctrl+Shift+Tab` 为 **“Previous recently viewed chat”**（另有 `Ctrl+PageDown/PageUp`、
`Ctrl+Shift+]`/`[` 等别名）；Codex 应用更新日志也提到加入了「跳转到最近线程的键盘快捷键」。
本插件按这个语义实现：

- 列表 = **最近查看顺序（MRU）**：当前会话 → 查看历史（最近查看的在前）→ 其余会话按侧边栏
  最近更新排序；每次查看会话都会更新查看历史；
- 按住修饰键时只移动高亮，**松开才切换**（VS Code / Alt-Tab 式 hold-modifier switcher）；
- 列表跳过已归档会话和子代理（subagent）会话；当前未开始的新会话排在最前。

参考链接：

- <https://defkey.com/chatgpt-windows-app-2026-shortcuts>（ChatGPT Windows App 26.x 快捷键表）
- <https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/changelog?type=codex-app>（Codex app 更新日志）

### 样式

面板沿用 DSH 菜单样式：`--dsw-specific-menu` 表面、`--dsw-elevation-prominent` 阴影、
`--dsw-radius-xl` 圆角、`--dsw-alias-state-business-primary` 选中强调色，跟随明暗主题；
行内显示会话标题、所属工作区与相对时间，当前会话带「当前」标记。

某一行的会话**正在运行**（active turn）时，行右侧显示一个 14px 的旋转圆圈，复用 DSH
侧边栏 `StateDot` 的 ongoing 外观：1.5s 线性旋转 + 1.5s 虚线弧动画，描边继承
`--dsw-alias-label-tertiary`；`prefers-reduced-motion` 下两段动画停止、弧固定。运行状态
来自 frame 槽作用域提供的 `useSessionStatus` 钩子（实时订阅），取不到时回退到会话列表
快照里的 `running` 提示；它会和「当前」标记并排显示，但始终位于最右侧。

### 文件

| 文件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `package.json` | 包清单：`dsh.bundle.patch` 声明 bundle 补丁，`dsh.client` 声明浏览器半体 |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | 向 profile 配置树插入 Host 行 `session-switcher` |
| `index.js` | Host 半体（无需挂载任何服务，空 `apply`） |
| `client.js` | 浏览器半体：fixed 输入动作 + `shell.overlay` 浮动窗 + 页面级 keyup/keydown 负责「松手提交 / Esc 取消」，并订阅会话列表维护最近查看顺序；window 捕获阶段区分「点中面板」与「点外取消」；运行中的会话行右侧渲染 `useSessionStatus` 旋转圆圈；内置中英文运行时文案 |
| `locale/*.json` | 插件市场/设置页里的标题与描述（中英文） |
| `icon.svg` | 插件图标 |
| `verify-client.cjs` | 本地校验脚本（不参与运行时）：用桩 React/DOM/服务执行真实 `client

plugins.description: Give the whole left column back to the conversation on narrow screens: below 1024px the DSH sidebar leaves the frame entirely and a header button opens it as an overlay drawer.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-mobile-sidebar

Give the whole left column back to the conversation on phones.

## What it changes

Below **1024px** — the same breakpoint at which `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-layout`
auto-collapses the sidebar — the stock web shell still keeps a **56px icon rail**
(`computeColumns()` resolves the collapsed track to `collapsedWidth`, which is 56 on
the web; only macOS desktop and the Windows titlebar shell pass 0). On a 390px
viewport that rail eats 14% of the screen for a column you cannot read anything in.

This plugin, under the same breakpoint:

| | stock | with the plugin |
|---|---|---|
| frame tracks at 390px | `56px 334px 0px` | `0px 390px 0px` |
| collapsed sidebar | 56px icon rail | nothing — no track, no paint |
| opening the sidebar | squeezes the centre to 110px | 300px drawer over a 390px centre, tap outside to close |
| header | no toggle | panel-left button at the header's leading edge |
| ≥ 1024px | — | untouched (`280px 1000px 0px`, button hidden) |

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add file:/path/to/dsh-mobile-sidebar
```

`dsh plugin add` appends the package to `dsh.profile.bundles` and hot-mounts it;
the browser only needs a **refresh** to load the new client combo. No `dsh web`
restart is required.

To remove it, delete the `"dsh-mobile-sidebar"` entry from `bundles` in
`~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json`, or disable the bundle from the Plugins
page.

## How it works

Everything is browser-side; the Host half is intentionally empty.

1. **Zero the sidebar track.** React writes `grid-template-columns` as an inline
   style, and a media query cannot override one track of it. A `MutationObserver`
   on the frame watches every solve, rewrites the value with **only the first
   track** replaced, and republishes it through the
   `--dsh-mobile-frame-cols` custom property. The centre and right tracks still
   matter between 800px and 1024px, where the right panel solves a real third
   track, so they are carried through untouched.
2. **Hide the rail without leaving the grid.** `visibility: hidden`, *not*
   `display: none`. A `display:none` box is not a grid item, so auto-placement
   slides the centre column into the now-0px first track and the conversation
   renders at zero width.
3. **Open as a drawer.** The column stays a grid item in its 0px track and simply
   overflows it (`position: relative` + an explicit width), so the centre column
   never changes width. A scrim in the `shell.overlay` slot closes it on tap.
4. **The toggle.** On the Conversation it is a primitives `Button` +
   `IconPanelLeftOutlineRegular` in the `conversation.header.leading` slot, calling
   `ctx.layout.toggleSidebar()`.

## Global panels (Plugins, Automation tasks, …)

The Conversation is the **only** panel that declares a header slot. Every other
global panel registers into the keyed `main` slot and builds its own heading —
Plugins renders `<header class="…pageHead">`, Schedules renders
`<div class="…pageHeading">`, and neither exposes anything to inject into.

So the toggle falls back to a fixed control rendered in `shell.overlay`, which
the shell always mounts at root scope. That covers every panel at once, including
panels that do not exist yet. Two rules keep it honest:

- **It steps aside on the Conversation.** `[frame]:not(:has([data-dsh-mobile-sidebar-button]))`
  is what hides it there, so the in-header button and the floating one never
  appear together.
- **It reserves its own lane.** Panel headings all start 28px down and 24px in,
  so the control would sit on the title's shoulder; a rule adds 40px of
  `padding-inline-start` to those headings while the control is present.

| where | control |
|---|---|
| Conversation | `conversation.header.leading` slot |
| Plugins / Schedules / any future panel | fixed control in `shell.overlay` |
| ≥ 1024px | neither |

## Screenshots

Closed on a phone — the rail is gone and the conversation keeps the full width:

![Mobile with the sidebar closed](docs/mobile-sidebar-hidden.png)

Tapping the header toggle opens the drawer over that same full-width conversation:

![Sidebar open as a drawer](docs/mobile-sidebar-drawer.png)

On a global panel the toggle falls back to a fixed control:

![Toggle fallback on the Plugins panel](docs/mobile-panel-toggle.png)

Above the breakpoint nothing changes:

![Desktop layout unchanged](docs/desktop-unchanged.png)

## Upgrades

The plugin targets source-written attributes, not the shell's CSS-module class
names (which are build-hashed and change between DSH releases):

- `[data-shell-overlay]` — the frame is its parent element
- `[data-slot="sidebar"]` — the sidebar column is its parent element
- `[data-sidebar-collapsed]` on the frame — closed vs. open
- `[data-plugin-panel]` — the one global panel that marks its section; the rest
  are matched on the `_pageHead` / `_pageHeading` class fragment

## License

MIT

plugins.description: 让你对模型说出“____“时模型不再困惑——dsh-ottosmother By DeepSeek-V4.1-flash1017的15,165,512tokens
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-ottosmother

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that gives the model a private glossary. The user
writes 「滚木」 meaning 「没有」 and 「棍母」 meaning 「不存在」; the model is told to
read those words as their meaning and, when it needs to express that meaning,
to phrase the whole sentence naturally with a glossary word instead of
mechanically swapping a single token.

The plugin only adds one **system prompt section**. It does not rewrite user
input, does not wrap model output, and does not register any message hooks.
A graphical settings page lets you manage the glossary files, the master
switch and the reminder strength without editing YAML by hand.

## Layout

```
glossaries/         # bundled category word lists (moba, fps, comments, ai, dev, private)
lib/config.js       # schema, YAML loading, prompt text builder, settings snapshot
lib/prompt.js       # system prompt section registration
lib/routes.js       # two local HTTP routes for the settings page
lib/index.js        # plugin entry
client.js           # settings page (Settings → dsh-ottosmother)
```

## Word lists

Word lists live in YAML files, not in the code. The package ships one file per
category (`glossaries/*.yaml`); your own files go to `~/.dsh/ottosmother/`
(created on demand by the settings page). Every file has the same shape:

```yaml
title: 我的词表            # group heading in the prompt
description: 说明           # shown in the settings page
terms:
  - word: 滚木
    meaning: 没有
  - word: 棍母
    meaning: 不存在
```

A file whose root is a plain list of `{ word, meaning }` items is accepted too.
File contents are re-read when the file's mtime/size changes, so edits take
effect on the next turn. The prompt itself contains only the glossary and
generic rules (read the word as its meaning, use the words when expressing that
meaning, keep code / commands / paths / URLs / error text verbatim). No example
sentences are hard-coded — how a particular word should be understood is left to
the model.

## Settings page

`Settings → dsh-ottosmother` (a `settings.section` slot):

- master switch and reminder strength (`quiet` / `normal` / `strong`);
- one switch per loaded glossary file (disabled files stay listed but are not
  injected);
- the resolved user directory and the bundled directory, each with an
  "open folder" button;
- a refresh button plus error/warning list for unreadable or broken YAML files.

Settings are written through `configForms`, so changes apply immediately
without reloading the plugin. The page talks to two exact host routes:

| Route | Method | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/dsh-ottosmother/catalog` | GET | JSON snapshot: files, counts, switches, directories, warnings |
| `/dsh-ottosmother/reveal` | POST | Create and open a glossary folder in the OS file manager |

Both routes are same-origin checked: loopback host only, cross-site requests
get 403, and no file content is ever written through them.

## How it works

| Extension point | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `systemPrompt.section` | Injects the 「私密词表」 section: glossary lines + generic reading/writing rules |
| `settings.section` (client) | Renders the settings page |
| `webServer` (exact routes) | Serves the catalog snapshot and the reveal action |

Section name `dsh-ottosmother/glossary`, order 50. The text is produced by a
function and re-read from config on every prompt assembly; when the plugin is
disabled or the word list is empty, the section text is an empty string and
nothing is injected. A broken YAML file is logged once instead of crashing the
session.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-ottosmother
```

Or from the release tarball / GitHub:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add https://github.com/hj9178/dsh-ottosmother/releases/download/v0.6.0/dsh-ottosmother-0.6.0.tgz
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:hj9178/dsh-ottosmother
```

Restart the harness after installing.

## Config

The settings page writes these fields, and you can also set them in the
profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-ottosmother
      name: 'dsh-ottosmother'
      inject: [systemPrompt]
      config:
        enabled: true
        reminder: normal
        disabledGlossaries: []
        glossaryDirs: []
        userDir: ''
        terms: []
```

- `enabled`: master switch; when false nothing is injected.
- `reminder`: `quiet` gives the list plus one line; `normal` explains reading
  and writing; `strong` explicitly asks the model to actively use the words.
- `disabledGlossaries`: file ids to switch off (`builtin:moba.yaml`,
  `user:mine.yaml`).
- `glossaryDirs`: extra directories to scan for `.yaml`/`.yml` word lists.
- `userDir`: personal glossary directory (empty = `~/.dsh/ottosmother`).
- `terms`: inline word list, merged after the files (duplicates dropped).

All settings-page fields are declared `.volatile()`, so edits apply immediately
on hosts that support it (schemastery ≥ 3.18.3).

## Known behaviour

- Whether the model writes 「滚木 / 棍母」 is its own decision; it may still say
  「没有」, and it may rewrite when explicitly asked.
- Code is not protected by code — the rule only asks the model to keep it
  verbatim.
- Other LLM calls in the harness (title generation, etc.) receive the same
  system prompt section.
- The settings page needs the harness Web host; headless profiles still get the
  prompt section, just no page.

## License

MIT.
