# dsh-ottosmother（中文）

给 DeepSeek Harness 的插件，把一份私人词表写进 system prompt：用户写
「滚木」要理解成「没有」，写「棍母」要理解成「不存在」；模型要表达「没有 /
不存在」时，用这些词把整句组织得自然通顺，而不是机械扣掉两个字再塞一个词。

插件只加一个 **system prompt 段落**：不改用户输入、不包装模型输出、不注册任何
消息钩子。设置界面里可以直接管理词表文件、总开关和提醒强度，不用手改 YAML。

## 结构

```
glossaries/         # 包内分类词表（moba、fps、comments、ai、dev、private）
lib/config.js       # schema、YAML 解析、提示词生成、设置页快照
lib/prompt.js       # system prompt 段落注册
lib/routes.js       # 设置页用的两条本地路由
lib/index.js        # 插件入口
client.js           # 设置页（设置 → dsh-ottosmother）
```

## 词表

词表放在 YAML 文件里，不写死在代码里。包内每个分类一个文件
（`glossaries/*.yaml`），自己的文件放 `~/.dsh/ottosmother/`（设置页首次打开
文件夹时自动创建）。所有文件格式一致：

```yaml
title: 我的词表            # 提示词里的分组标题
description: 说明           # 设置页里显示的说明
terms:
  - word: 滚木
    meaning: 没有
  - word: 棍母
    meaning: 不存在
```

根节点直接是 `{ word, meaning }` 数组的写法也接受。文件 mtime/size 变化时下次
组装自动重读，改完下一轮对话即生效。提示词本身只有词表和通用规则（按含义理解、
需要时用这些词表达、代码 / 命令 / 路径 / URL / 报错原文保持原样），不写死任何
例句——某个词具体该怎么理解，交给模型自己判断。

## 设置页

`设置 → dsh-ottosmother`（`settings.section` 槽位）：

- 总开关和提醒强度（`quiet` / `normal` / `strong`）；
- 每个已加载词表文件一个开关（关掉的文件仍列在清单里，只是不注入）；
- 个人词表目录和包内目录，各带一个「打开文件夹」按钮；
- 刷新按钮，以及读取失败 / YAML 损坏的提示列表。

设置通过 `configForms` 写入，改完即时生效，不用重载插件。页面只调用两条
exact 路由：

| 路由 | 方法 | 用途 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/dsh-ottosmother/catalog` | GET | JSON 快照：文件清单、词条数、开关、目录、警告 |
| `/dsh-ottosmother/reveal` | POST | 创建并在系统文件管理器打开词表目录 |

两条路由都做同源校验：只接受 loopback host，跨站请求返回 403，且不通过路由写
任何词表内容。

## 生效方式

| 扩展点 | 做什么 |
| --- | --- |
| `systemPrompt.section` | 注入「私密词表」段落：词表 + 通用理解/表达规则 |
| `settings.section`（客户端） | 渲染设置页 |
| `webServer`（exact 路由） | 提供词表快照与打开文件夹 |

段落名 `dsh-ottosmother/glossary`，order 50。文本由函数提供，每次组装 prompt
时现读配置；插件关闭或词表为空时返回空串，等价于不注入。YAML 损坏只记一次
日志，不会让会话崩溃。

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-ottosmother
```

或从 GitHub / Release 安装：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add https://github.com/hj9178/dsh-ottosmother/releases/download/v0.6.0/dsh-ottosmother-0.6.0.tgz
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:hj9178/dsh-ottosmother
```

安装后重启 harness 生效。

## 配置

设置页写入的就是这些字段，也可以写在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-ottosmother
      name: 'dsh-ottosmother'
      inject: [systemPrompt]
      config:
        enabled: true
        reminder: normal
        disabledGlossaries: []
        glossaryDirs: []
        userDir: ''
        terms: []
```

- `enabled`：总开关，关掉后不注入任何内容。
- `reminder`：提醒强度。`quiet` 只给词表加一行；`normal` 说明理解与表达；
  `strong` 明确要求模型主动使用这些词。
- `disabledGlossaries`：关掉的词表文件 id（`builtin:moba.yaml`、`user:mine.yaml`）。
- `glossaryDirs`：额外扫描的 `.yaml`/`.yml` 词表目录。
- `userDir`：个人词表目录（留空用 `~/.dsh/ottosmother`）。
- `terms`：内联词条，在文件之后合并（重复项自动去掉）。

设置页字段都声明了 `.volatile()`，在支持的宿主（schemastery ≥ 3.18.3）上改完
即时生效。

## 已知行为

- 模型是否用「滚木 / 棍母」表达由模型自己判断，可能偶尔说成「没有」。
- 代码没有被代码保护——规则只是要求模型

plugins.description: 小舞 · DSH 桌宠：原创 SVG 手绘兔耳少女，跟随 agent 状态换动作，运行时合成甜声说「做完啦……」。无任何外部素材或录音。
plugins.readme_text:
# 小舞 · DSH 桌宠（dsh-plugin-xiaowu）

一个常驻 DSH Web 界面右下角的桌面宠物插件。她会跟着当前会话里 agent 的工作状态换动作，
任务做完的时候跳起来撒花，并且用一段**运行时合成的甜美声音**说一句「做完啦……」。
声音不是任何录音或采样：全部由 WebAudio 振荡器实时合成（详见下面「声音设计」）。

> 角色形象是按「斗罗大陆里那位兔耳少女」的气质**原创绘制**的 SVG 小人（粉发、兔耳、长辫、
> 白色兔耳发饰、粉色裙装），不是任何动画素材或截图的搬运。

## 原创说明

这是本人（jxboop）的原创作品：

- **形象**：纯手写 SVG 绘制的 chibi 小人。粉发、兔耳、长辫、白色兔耳发饰、粉白连衣裙，
  都是一条条 `<path>` / `<circle>` 画出来的，没有使用任何动画截图、贴图或第三方素材。
  气质上致敬「斗罗大陆」里的兔耳少女小舞，但**不是**该作品的官方形象，也没有搬运其素材。
- **动作**：七个心情各自的 keyframes（呼吸、眨眼、甩辫、抡锤、蹦跳、垂耳、Zzz）为自己编写。
- **状态机**：`PetFollow` 如何把 DSH 会话事件折叠成心情、以及「先补读事件日志再判定
  成功还是报错」的时序，为自己设计。
- **声音**：全部由 WebAudio 振荡器实时合成，没有任何录音或采样文件。四音节旋律动机、
  FM 共振峰、气音瞬态、立体声摆位都是自己调参的。
- **代码**：Host 半边、浏览器半边与测试套件为本项目原创，采用 MIT 许可。

二次创作或商用请遵守 MIT 许可并保留作者署名。

## 目录

- [她长什么样](#她长什么样)
- [她会做什么](#她会做什么)
- [声音设计](#声音设计)
- [原创说明](#原创说明)
- [安装与卸载](#安装与卸载)
- [更新流程](#更新流程)
- [开发与自测](#开发与自测)
- [实现说明](#实现说明)
- [许可](#许可)

-----

## 她长什么样

纯手写 SVG 画的 chibi 小人，约 112px 高，贴在窗口右下角：粉发 + 前额刘海、两条细长兔耳、
一条垂到脚边的长辫（末端系蝴蝶结）、白色兔耳发饰、粉白连衣裙配缎带、脚上小圆靴。
她有一缕很淡的灵光在背后呼吸；眼睛会跟着鼠标转。

`preview.html` / `preview-zoom.html` 是真实浏览器渲染出来的七个心情状态预览页，
用浏览器直接打开就能看到（`preview-zoom.html` 是放大 4.2 倍细看版）。

## 她会做什么

心情由**当前会话**（`ctx.sessions.list.current`）的真实状态推导，不是随机播放：

| 心情 | 触发条件 | 动作 | 声音 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `idle` 待机 | 会话空闲 | 呼吸、眨眼、耳朵轻抖、偶尔甩辫子 | 偶尔一声轻跳 |
| `think` 思考 | 正在跑，但还没发工具 | 左右轻晃、头顶冒「?」 | — |
| `work` 干活 | 最新事件是 `tool/call` | 抡小锤子、火星四溅、汗滴 | 每次新工具一声轻脆 tick |
| `wait` 等确认 | `approval/asked` 尚未 `decided` | 举手、头顶「!」、光圈脉动 | 柔和上行双音 |
| `done` 完成 | 一轮 `turn/end` 成功结束（running 由真变假） | 原地跳起、爱心+星星+音符 | **「做完啦……」** + 收尾闪音 |
| `oops` 出错 | `lastAgentError` 或 `turn/end reason=error` | 耳朵垂下、冒汗、掉泪 | 下行小三度 |
| `sleep` 睡觉 | 90 秒没动静，或还没打开任何会话 | 闭眼、冒 Zzz | 四声下行摇篮曲 |

交互：

- **点她一下**：蹦一下 + 一声「啵」，泡泡里冒出「呼哇～好舒服！」。
- **点右上角小喇叭**：开关声音（选择记在 `localStorage`，键名 `dsh-plugin-xiaowu:audio`）。
- **点状态胶囊 / 悬停**：展开小面板，显示当前心情、正在用的工具名、会话标题。
- 浏览器禁止自动播放音频，所以第一次点击/按键时才会解锁 AudioContext；解锁**之前**她依然会动，只是不出声。
- 尊重 `prefers-reduced-motion`：动画会被压到最短。

## 声音设计

四段「咿呀」的旋律动机对应语音的音节节奏，全部由 `lib/client.js` 里的 `voice` 模块现场合成：

| 时间 | 音高 | 对应 | 音色处理 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0.00s–0.24s | G5 (784Hz) | 「做」 | 三角波主音 + FM 调制 + 气音瞬态 |
| 0.20s–0.50s | A5 (880Hz) | 「完」 | 同上，略强 |
| 0.47s–0.77s | G5 (784Hz) | 「啦」 | 同上，稍弱 |
| 0.75s–1.41s | D5 (587Hz) | 「……」 | 长音下滑，收尾 |
| 1.32s–1.82s | G5→C6→E6 | 闪音 | 铃铛式正弦 + 二次谐波 |

每个音节叠了三层：

1. **主音**：`triangle` 振荡器，带 5.4Hz 轻微颤音（`vibrato`），起音有 20–45ms 的滑入（`ramp`）。
2. **FM 调制**：`sine` 调制器以约 1.7 倍基频调制主音频率，做出类似人声共振峰的「唔」感。
3. **气音瞬态**：40ms 白噪声经带通滤波（中心频率约 1.7 倍基频），模拟辅音起音，让音节听起来像「说话」而不是纯音阶。
4. **低八度衬底**：每个音节再加一层低八度正弦，音量约 30%，让声音有胸腔共鸣的暖度，不会太尖。

再加一层立体声：四个音节左右轻摆（-0.22 / 0.06 / 0.24 / 0），闪音尾随其后，听感更「甜甜的」。
整段约 1.9 秒，主输出增益 0.9、单音峰值 0.13–0.20，保证不会突然吓人。

其他提示音（`hop` / `tick` / `chime` / `oops` / `pop` / `lullaby`）用同一套 `bell()` 原语拼出来。
想换音高或换成整句语音朗读，改 `phrase()` 里的 `notes` 数组即可。

## 安装与卸载

### 环境要求

| 项目 | 要求 |
| --- | --- |
| DSH | 已在跑 `dsh web`（有 `web` profile） |
| Node.js | ≥ 18 |
| git | 安装时需要 |
| 浏览器 | 支持 Web Audio（Chrome / Edge / Firefox / Safari 都行） |

### 安装

```bash
git clone https://github.com/jxboop/dsh-plugin-xiaowu.git
node dsh-plugin-xiaowu/install.mjs
```

PowerShell（5.1 不支持 `&&`，用分号）：

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/jxboop/dsh-plugin-xiaowu.git; node .\dsh-plugin-xiaowu\install.mjs
```

脚本幂等，做四件事：

1. 把插件放进 `<DSH 主目录>/plugin-src/dsh-plugin-xiaowu`
2. 在 `<profile>/node_modules` 建链接（Windows 用 junction，**无需管理员权限**）
3. 把包名写进 `<profile>/package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`（只改这一个字段）
4. 打印重启指引

然后：

1. `Ctrl+C` 停掉 `dsh web`，重新执行 `dsh web`
2. 浏览器 `Ctrl+Shift+R` 硬刷新

**为什么必须重启**：bundle 列表与插件树只在进程启动时组合，热加载覆盖不到新装的插件。

常用参数：

```bash
node install.mjs --profile web            # 指定 profile（默认 web）
node install.mjs --dsh-home D:\dsh-home    # 自定义 DSH 主目录
node install.mjs --source ./本地目录        # 从本地目录安装（改代码时用）
node install.mjs --help
```

DSH 主目录默认按 `$DSH_HOME` → `~/.dsh` 的顺序推断。

### 只想先看看她长什么样

不用装插件：用浏览器直接打开仓库里的 `preview.html`（`preview-zoom.html` 是放大 4.2 倍细看版）。

### 卸载

```bash
node dsh-plugin-xiaowu/uninstall.mjs           # 移除链接与 bundles 注册，保留插件目录
node dsh-plugin-xiaowu/uninstall.mjs --purge   # 连插件目录一起删
```

重启 `dsh web` 生效。

### 改完源码怎么生效

重开 `dsh web`（或重启当前那个进程），再刷新浏览器页面。
profile 的 `patchReload` 是 `live`，所以首页刷新会重新拿配置；但已经在跑的进程不会重新组合插件树。

## 更新流程（不用重启）

如果你的 DSH 装了 `dsh-super-injector`（本机开发常用的可选工具），改完源码可以热重载，不必重启：

1. **改**：动 `lib/client.js`（浏览器半边）或 `lib/index.js`（node 半边）。
2. **自测**：跑下面「开发与自测」里的测试。
3. **推送**：让注入器热重载这个包 ——

```
dev_reload_package  packageName: dsh-plugin-xiaowu
```

它清掉该包的模块缓存、重建 fiber，并把新的客户端 bundle 以新 revision 发布出去（失败会自动回滚保留旧代）。
之后**刷新浏览器页面**即可，不用重启 `dsh web`。

没有注入器也没关系：改完重启 `dsh web` 即可。

### 怎么确认刷新后跑的确实是新版本

bundle 里有一个版本戳常量 `BUILD`（`lib/client.js` 顶部，语义化版本，改完记得 +1）。
载入时它会把 `window.__DSH_XIAOWU__` 挂到页面上并打一行日志：

```
[xiaowu] 桌宠已载入 build 0.1.2 — window.__DSH_XIAOWU__ 可核对
```

刷新后的页面在 DevTools 控制台里敲 `window.__DSH_XIAOWU__.build`，跟文件里的 `BUILD` 对得上，
就说明这一页跑的是磁盘上这一版，而不是缓存的旧 bundle。

## 开发与自测

```bash
node --check lib/client.js      # 语法
node test/harness.cjs           # 无浏览器：挂载 + 状态机（各个心情逐个断言）
```

需要浏览器级渲染的测试要装开发依赖（只有改代码的人需要）：

```bash
npm i                           # jsdom / react / react-dom
node test/dom.cjs               # jsdom + 真 React 18：真渲染、真 DOM、真音频调度、版本戳
node test/preview.cjs           # 生成 preview.html / preview-zoom.html
```

## 实现说明

插件是**双面**的（DSH 客户端插件的标准形态）：

- **node 半边**（`lib/index.js`）：空的 `apply()`。它的唯一作用是让 Cordis 树里出现这一行，
  这样 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-modules` 扫描 `dsh.client` 声明时能发现本包。
- **浏览器半边**（`lib/client.js`）：手写的懒 CJS bundle，通过 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load`
  注册工厂；不需要任何构建步骤（没有 JSX，用 `React.createElement` 的 `h()` 小助手）。

浏览器半边做了三件事：

1. **占位**：`ctx.slots.inject("shell.overlay", …)` —— `shell.overlay` 是 ui-layout 声明的
   「整框浮动层」，本身是点击穿透的，所以 CSS 里只有 `.dsh-xw-stage` 把自己重新打开
   `pointer-events:auto`，不会挡住下面的界面。
2. **读状态**：`PetFollow` 跟着 `ctx.sessions` 走。它订阅会话列表（当前会话变化）、
   会话快照（`running`、`lastAgentError`、`awaitingFirstTurn`）和事件窗口
   （`turn/start`、`turn/end`、`tool/call`、`tool/result`、`approval/asked`、`approval/decided`），
   把它们折叠成上面那张表里的七个心情。**顺序很讲究**：running 由真变假时先补读一遍事件日志，
   再判断是「做完」还是「出错」，所以一轮报错的 turn 不会被误当成成功来庆祝。
3. **画与响**：React 组件读 store，把心情写到 `data-mood` 上，CSS 里每个心情一套 keyframes；
   `useMoodSounds` 在心情**边沿**触发对应音效（`done` 边沿就是那句「做完啦……」）。

依赖清单写在自己的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里（一行 insert），`package.json` 的 `dsh.client.inject`
声明了必须先在线的客户端插件，剩下的 `react` / `react-dom` 走 DSH 客户端的静态模块表，不需要额外依赖。

## 许可

形象、动作、状态机与全部音频合成算法均为原创；二次创作或商用请遵守 MIT 许可并保留署名。

plugins.description: Session trash for DeepSeek Harness Desktop: move sessions to a recoverable trash from the sidebar, restore or purge them from a settings page.
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-session-trash **Session Trash for DeepSeek Harness Desktop** — move a session into a recoverable trash from the sidebar menu, then restore or permanently purge it from **Settings → Session Trash**. English | [中文](README.zh.md) ![Session Trash icon](icon.svg) ## Summary Harness keeps every session log forever. `sessionPersistence` has no deletion API — *"Nothing deletes session files"* — and the workspace registry only archives, leaving the log on disk. This plugin adds the missing capability in the safest shape it can take: a **recoverable** move, a **user-only** trigger, and no filesystem path ever crossing the wire. ## Table of Contents - [Use this plugin](#use-this-plugin) - [Configuration](#configuration) - [Safety model](#safety-model) - [Scope](#scope) - [Verification](#verification) - [Further exploration](#further-exploration) - [Disclaimer](#disclaimer) - [Known limitations](#known-limitations) ----- ## Use this plugin | Where | What it does | |---|---| | Session row → `…` menu | **Move to trash** — the host's own `MenuItemButton` geometry (same height, padding, icon cell and label rhythm) with its danger colouring | | Confirmation dialog | Shows the title, original path and size before anything moves; the destructive confirm is the host's outline-with-red-text pattern | | Settings → **Session Trash** | Lists deleted sessions with **Restore** and **Purge**, plus **Empty trash** | | Host startup | Removes entries older than `retentionDays` (default 30), silently | A deletion **moves the session's directory** with a single `rename` into `$DSH_HOME/session-trash/-/`, and writes a `manifest.json` beside it. Nothing is copied, so an interruption cannot leave a half-deleted session, and a failed move leaves both directories exactly as they were. ### Install The plugin is an ordinary Harness bundle, so it installs where every other plugin does: ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:xxiiiixx/dsh-session-trash ``` From a local checkout, point Plugin Manager at the directory (Settings → Plugins → Add, or the `plugin_manager` tool with `install_bundle`). The row it inserts is named `dsh-session-trash`, and it is enabled immediately. Restart Harness if Plugin Manager reports `restart-required`. ### Updating an installed copy A GitHub install copies the package into the profile's `node_modules`; it does **not** link back to a checkout. Editing a checkout therefore changes nothing until the change is pushed and the installed copy is replaced. ```bash cd git add -A && git commit -m "..." && git push ``` Then tell Plugin Manager to reinstall the bundle (`remove_bundle` followed by `install_bundle` with `github:xxiiiixx/dsh-session-trash`, or the same two steps in Settings → Plugins). Reinstalling a package requires a Harness restart to load the fresh JavaScript generation for the Host half; the Client half is picked up on the next page load. If you would rather have a checkout's edits take effect immediately, install it by directory path instead — that produces a junction into the profile, and a moved or renamed checkout then breaks the plugin, because the link points at the old location. ## Configuration The bundle patch inserts the Host row with no config: the plugin resolves both roots from the running DSH home at activation, so a normal install needs no per-machine editing. Every field stays overridable from the profile's own patch layer. | Field | Default | Meaning | |---|---|---| | `sessionsRoot` | `$DSH_HOME/sessions` | Where the session backend stores logs | | `trashRoot` | `$DSH_HOME/session-trash` | Where deleted sessions go; must be on the same volume as `sessionsRoot` | | `retentionDays` | `30` | Automatic purge age; `0` disables the sweep | | `sweepOnStart` | `true` | Run the retention sweep once per Host start | | `maxTrashEntries` | `500` | Refuse new deletions above this count; `0` means unlimited | ```yaml - id: dsh-session-trash name: 'dsh-session-trash' config: retentionDays: 90 ``` ## Safety model Deleting a session is destructive, so most of this plugin is refusals rather than deletion. 1. **Recoverable by default.** A deletion is a move, not an unlink. Purging is a separate, explicit action inside the trash page. 2. **No path crosses the wire.** The client sends `{ op, sessionId }` or `{ op, trashId }`. The Host resolves identifiers against its own roots; there is no `path` field to smuggle. 3. **Identifiers are whitelisted** (`^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$`, ≤ 200 characters, never `.`/`..`) and every resolved path is checked with `path.relative` after `realpath`, so a symlink or a crafted id cannot escape a root. 4. **Directories prove their identity.** Before moving anything the plugin reads the log's header line and refuses unless `header.id` matches the requested session. 5. **Only a running turn blocks a delete.** Liveness is read exactly the way the shipped archive action reads it: an Agent counts as busy only while its `status` is `running`. An idle Agent that merely stays resident in the registry does **not** block — a session you already stopped is deletable. An Agent surface that cannot report a status is treated as running, so the plugin never guesses its way into moving a log that may still be written. 6. **A derived subagent session travels with its parent; a fork does not.** A session with `origin: subagent` exists only to carry out work for its parent, so a stopped one moves into the *same* trash entry and returns with the parent on restore. A fork (`isSeeded`) is seeded from the parent's history and then stands on its own: it stays put and does not block. A derived child that is still running, or that has children of its own, refuses the whole carry and says why. 7. **`rename` only, never copy-then-delete.** `EXDEV`, `EPERM` and `EBUSY` are reported as `cross-volume` / `busy`; no fallback exists that could leave a duplicate or a partial copy. 8. **Serialized mutations.** One promise chain per service, plus a re-run of every preflight immediately before the move, which closes the window between the dialog and the action. 9. **No agent tool.** The Host half registers no tool at all. Only a person clicking the UI can delete a session; the model cannot. 10. **One endpoint, behind the standard fence.** `POST /api/session-trash` is mounted on `ctx.connection.fetch`, so it inherits Harness's Host/Origin and browser-credential checks. Bodies are capped at 64 KiB, operations are a closed set, and failures answer with a stable `code` plus a fixed sentence — never a filesystem path. 11. **The Host log is the source of truth.** Deletion drops the session from the workspace pin/archive sets and emits `api-session/removed`, the same event the sidebar already listens for, so the row disappears immediately without any plugin-private state. ## Scope - **Allowed:** any session that is not running and whose derived children, if any, are stopped. - **Refused:** a running session or derived child, a derived child that has children, a directory that is not provably that session, and anything outside the configured root. - **Not touched:** attachments referenced by the deleted log (the attachment store is global and immutable), and projection-cache rows (they are hints only and self-heal). ## Verification ```bash npm test # 65 cases: paths, config, trash service, HTTP route, Client bundle npm run e2e # end-to-end walk through the HTTP handler npm run audit # read-only verdict for every real session on this machine npm run check:css # diff the copied styles against the host's own stylesheet npm run check:liveness ``` The suite builds throwaway session roots with real Zstandard logs and asserts: read-only preflight, identity-mismatch refusal, running and derived-child refusals, atomic move with rollback, manifest round-trip, restore collision, purge containment (`../../etc` is rejecte

plugins.description: Give the agent a real headed browser: browser_open and browser_interact tools over a stateful Chromium installed under the harness home
plugins.readme_text:
# 内置浏览器（dsh-browser）

给 Agent 一个**真实的有头浏览器**：`browser_open` / `browser_interact` 两个工具，跑在一个装在
harness home 下、状态可保持的 Chromium 上。

## 有什么

- **`browser_open`**：打开页面，返回可交互的页面状态。
- **`browser_interact`**：在同一个浏览器会话里点击、输入、滚动、读取——状态在多次调用之间保持。
- **设置页**：Agent 使用开关、请求头编辑器、Chromium 安装状态。
- **Chromium 管理**：检测 / 安装 / 复用，装在 `~/.dsh` 下，不污染系统。

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin add @istarry/dsh-browser
```

装完重启 DSH 服务。**首次使用需要在设置页里安装 Chromium**（约 400MB 下载，几百个文件），
装好之后不再重复下载。

## 权限与行为

这是本插件最需要注意的部分——它不只是渲染界面：

- 会**下载并安装一个 Chromium 运行时**到 `~/.dsh` 下（首次约 400MB，需要网络）。
- 会**启动一个有头浏览器进程**（不是无头），占用内存与一个窗口。
- `browser_interact` 能让模型**操作真实网页**：点击、输入、提交表单。请在设置页里决定是否对
  Agent 开放（`agentUseBrowser`），并清楚这意味着模型可以碰到你打开的任何页面。
- 可自定义**请求头**（设置页），用于需要特定 UA / Referer 的场景。

## 兼容性

- 实测于 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`。
- peer 依赖：`@deepseek-ai/cordis`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-session` 等
  （见各自 package.json）。
- Chromium 运行时**不随包分发**，由插件在运行时安装到用户目录。

## 结构

| 包 | 职责 |
|---|---|
| `@istarry/dsh-browser` | Chromium 运行时管理、`browser_open` / `browser_interact` 工具、安装/检测 Remote |
| `@istarry/dsh-client-ui-settings-browser` | 设置页：Agent 使用开关、请求头编辑、安装状态 |

## 许可

MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

# dsh-latex

> **English** | [中文](./README.zh.md)

Make the DeepSeek Harness chat render formulae as formulae, and make the model **write LaTeX by default** instead of wrapping math in `latex` fences.

## What it fixes

DSH's frontend already renders TeX through KaTeX (`MarkdownText` in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`), but:

| Symptom | Cause | What this plugin does |
|---|---|---|
| Formulae show up as a grey code block | The model writes them in ```` ```latex ```` / ```` ```tex ```` fences, which the frontend never renders (only `$...$`, `$$...$$`, `\(...\)`, `\[...\]` and ```` ```math ```` are supported) | The host half states the output contract in the system prompt; the browser half renders legacy `latex`/`tex` fences in place |
| During streaming the answer shows raw `$` and `\frac` | The frontend deliberately keeps TeX literal while streaming and swaps in KaTeX once the message settles | Left alone (upstream design); renders correctly after settling |
| A few formulae turn into harsh red text | KaTeX strict mode: `align`, `\si{}`, `\ce{}` are outside the supported subset | Forbidden by the prompt; the browser half turns the red error into a readable badge |
| Wide display math overflows the bubble | KaTeX display blocks do not scroll by default | The browser half adds horizontal scrolling and padding |

## Install

### From GitHub (recommended)

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:sbVAN/dsh-latex
```

Restart DeepSeek Harness afterwards, then reload the page once (the browser half needs to load the new bundle).

### Development: link a local checkout

```powershell
# 1. register a link dependency in the profile package.json:
#    "dsh-latex": "link:Z:/文件留存/deepseek project/dsh-latex"
# 2. create the junction (the equivalent of pnpm's link:)
New-Item -ItemType Junction `
  -Path "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-latex" `
  -Target "Z:\文件留存\deepseek project\dsh-latex"
# 3. append to the profile's cordis.patch.yml:
#    - insert:
#        - id: latex
#          name: dsh-latex
# 4. restart DeepSeek Harness (the host half needs the new composition)
```

After that the browser half can hot-reload through HMR when `hmr.root` covers the plugin sources.

## Configuration

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: latex
      name: dsh-latex
      config:
        strict: true
        compact: false
        locale: zh
        extraRules:
          - Write water as $\mathrm{H_2O}$, never \ce{}.
```

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | Disables the prompt section entirely (the browser half still runs) |
| `locale` | `auto` | `zh` / `en` / `auto` (auto follows `DSH_LOCALE`, `LANG`, defaulting to Chinese) |
| `strict` | `true` | `true` forbids fenced formulae; `false` only recommends |
| `compact` | `false` | Shorter prompt, roughly 1/3 of the tokens |
| `order` | `145` | Section order inside the system prompt (tool guidance owns 100–199) |
| `extraRules` | `[]` | Extra bullet lines appended to the contract |

## Behaviour

### Host half (`lib/index.js`)

Registers `ctx.systemPrompt.section({ name: 'dsh-latex:math-output', order, text })` with a contract covering inline `$...$`, display `$$...$$`, a ban on fenced formulae, the KaTeX-supported subset (`aligned` over `align`, `pmatrix`/`bmatrix`/`cases`, `\mathrm{}` over `\si{}`/`\pu{}`/`\ce{}`, no `\label`/`\tag`), CJK only inside `\text{}`, and splitting long derivations.

The section is disposed with the plugin fiber, so hot reload cannot leave duplicates. The rendered contract is written to `$DSH_HOME/cache/dsh-latex/prompt.txt`, mount diagnostics to `mounted.json`.

### Browser half (`lib/client.js`)

- display-math scrolling and an error badge;
- `pre > code.language-latex|tex` gets a preview below it, rendered with the shared `MarkdownText` (no bundled KaTeX), source folded by default;
- toolbar with show/hide source and copy LaTeX;
- 300 ms debounce over a full scan, orphan cleanup, and root unmount when React replaces nodes.

## Limitations

- **No math while streaming** — that is the frontend's deliberate behaviour and this plugin does not fight it.
- **Only `latex` / `tex` fences are handled** — `math` fences are already rendered upstream.
- **No mhchem** — `\ce{}` / `\pu{}` still fail; the prompt routes them to `\mathrm{}`.
- **No `conversation.chat.node` takeover** — replacing the assistant renderer means duplicating the whole message structure and breaks on upstream upgrades.
- **No history rewriting** — the prompt constrains future output only; old sessions are covered by the browser half.

## Rollback

Remove the junction, drop the insert line from `cordis.patch.yml`, restore the profile `package.json`, restart. No DSH file is modified.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Delete DSH (DeepSeek Harness) sessions and workspace data from the Web GUI — a per-session Delete menu row, a management settings page with sizes, and a restorable trash.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-manager

English | [فارسی](README.fa.md)

**Session deletion for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI.**

DSH can archive sessions but never delete them — the shipped persistence layer
has no deletion API, and workspace deletion keeps every session log on disk.
This plugin fills that gap:

- **Sidebar** — every session's `…` menu gets a **Delete…** row (after the
  shipped *Copy Session ID*), with a confirmation dialog.
- **Settings → Session Manager** — a management page listing every registered
  workspace and every orphaned directory with per-session sizes, event counts,
  and dates: per-row delete, checkbox bulk delete, and *Delete workspace data…*
  (removes the registration **and** its session logs). A **search box** matches
  title / session id / path, and an **older-than** filter narrows the list by
  last activity.
- **Trash, not `rm`** — deleted session directories are *moved* to
  `$DSH_HOME/trash/sessions/<timestamp>--<id>/` with a `manifest.json`, so the
  settings page can **Restore** them until you *Empty trash*.

## How it works

```
┌──────────────────────┐  same-origin fetch   ┌─────────────────────────────┐
│ lib/client.js        │ ───────────────────▶ │ lib/index.js (Host half)    │
│  • menu slot row     │  /session-manager-…  │  • authenticated HTTP route │
│  • settings page     │ ◀────────────────── │  • workspaceRegistry        │
└──────────────────────┘      JSON           │  • sessionPersistence       │
                                             │  • archive → move to trash │
                                             └─────────────────────────────┘
```

Third-party client bundles get no package RPC channel in DSH (the Remote
namespaces are fixed at build time), so the two halves talk over the plugin's
own HTTP route registered through `ctx.webServer` — the documented
route-owner pattern. Every request passes the same browser trust fence as the
shipped `/api` route (`ctx.connection.requestRejection`), so only an
authenticated DSH page can call it; the browser's signed cookie rides the
same-origin `fetch` automatically.

Deletion flow per session: refuse if live → archive through
`workspaceRegistry.archiveSession` (so the row leaves the sidebar's default
*Hide archived* view immediately) → `rename` the session directory into the
trash → drop the empty project directory. Workspace purge: refuse if any of
its sessions is live → `workspaceRegistry.delete` → move every session
directory of that path to the trash.

## Install

Install straight from this repository — a Git address is a valid plugin spec:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/mehdinikzad68/dsh-session-manager
```

or paste the same URL into the Web GUI's **Plugins → Add plugin** dialog. For a
local checkout, pass the package directory's path instead. The bundle is
enabled on install: profiles with `patchReload: live` mount it without a
restart, while startup-only profiles (such as the Desktop profile) need one
DSH restart.

## Safety

- A **live** session (present in the in-memory session store or the agent
  registry) is always refused — stop it first.
- Deletion is a move, never an unlink: everything is recoverable from the
  trash until *Empty trash*.
- The HTTP API enforces DSH's browser authentication (401/403 otherwise).

## Limitations

- The sessions root is derived as `$DSH_HOME/sessions` (default `~/.dsh/sessions`).
  A profile that configures a different persistence `root` is not detected
  (v0.1).
- Session titles come from cached projection hints; sessions without hints
  show their id.
- `restore` recreates the directory (and unarchives if we archived it), but a
  workspace whose registration was purged must be re-registered by opening
  the folder again.
- After a delete, the sidebar hides the row via archive; the session summary
  disappears from lists on the next refresh.

## Roadmap

Feature ideas on deck, roughly in order — several inspired by the community
plugin [dsh-session-manager](https://github.com/hkkz9522/dsh-session-manager)
by hkkz9522:

- **Richer batch mode** — select-all-matching, per-group actions, and a
  preview summary dialog before destructive bulk deletes.
- **Workspace visibility** — archive/unarchive a whole workspace from the
  management page.

## License

MIT © Mehdi Nikzad

plugins.description: 让文本模型读懂一首歌：本地音乐分析插件，把音频拆成能量、速度、调性、密度，音频不出本机。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-soundcheck

> 文本模型看不见声音。这个插件把一首歌拆成它能读的东西。

丢一首本地音频给它，它把能量、速度、调性、编曲密度量一遍，
再合成一段人话——哪里最满、哪一下反差最大、收尾是淡出还是硬切。

**它不是让模型"听见"，是让模型"读懂"。** 没有多模态，也能对一首歌说上话；
代价是它只知道结构，不知道声音长什么样——人声、歌词、乐器只给方向，
能说的和不能说的它都会标出来。

说白了：**给一首歌做体检**。时长、响度、有没有削波、拍速、调性这些硬指标它说得比较准。

**音频不出本机。** 没有上传、没有联网、没有云端分析。

---

## 它真能帮上什么

不是吹的，下面这些是从实际对话里试出来的：

**一首老钢琴曲**，它能说出：
> 4 分 10 秒、99 拍；D# 大调但不太稳；前 16 秒几乎空着，之后一路铺满；
> 2:24 之后越往后越密；3:12 抽空 18 dB，3:28 又砸回来；4:00 淡出但底下还有东西。

它报告里说的那三件事，在曲线上就是三个点：

![能量曲线：3:12 抽空、3:28 砸回、4:00 淡出](docs/energy-piano.png)

**一首古筝领奏的器乐**：
> 慢热型：前 32 秒铺垫，1:52 最密，2:24 开始加厚，4:32 塌下去、4:48 硬收尾。
> 和声一直在 D–E–F# 上打转，听感偏五声。

它还押了一句"民族/东方融合、偏配乐或国风电子"——**方向是对的，但这是推断，不是测量**。

**一份只有鼓和贝斯的半成品**：
> 低频占满、中高频空着；峰值 −3.7 dBFS、整体 −21.8 dBFS，还有 6–8 dB 余量。

这种"还差多少电平"的判断，对做混音的人最直接。

它不是在"听懂"，它是把能量、密度、调性这些量出来，再合成一段判断。

---

## 它是怎么做到的

本机解码，然后算几样东西：

- **能量曲线**：16 秒一块，绝对 dBFS，不归一化；
- **节拍**：两条独立算法交叉验证，所以能发现"半速/双倍速"；
- **调性**：Krumhansl 模板 + 候选排序，模板不适用时会直说；
- **和弦**：只到根音级，不硬猜大/小三度和七度；
- **编曲密度**：起音密度、频谱变化率，用来判断"满不满"；
- **声源**：一个 16 MB 的小模型看"像什么"，只当方向。

最后把这些合成三段：`[判断]`（结论）、`[依据]`（数字）、`[可信]`（哪些能信）。

没有大模型，不联网，音频不出本机。

你看到的三个能力，其实是三种问法：

- `audio_analyze` —— 整首
- `audio_section` —— 某一段
- `audio_provision` —— 装运行环境（`/audio-install` 背后就是它，也可以让助手直接调）

---

## 装

**需要**：Windows、Python 3.10+（命令行能跑 `python -V`）、约 550 MB 磁盘、第一次要联网。

**三种装法，选一个：**

1. DSH 插件管理界面 → 从本地文件夹安装
2. 命令行：
   ```
   dsh plugin --profile desktop add "<你解压出来的目录>"
   ```
3. 直接跟 DSH 说："把这个插件装上，目录是 ……"，让它自己装。

装完**重启 DSH**。

然后装运行环境——**这一步不会自己偷偷开始**，得你点一下：

- 在 DSH 里输入 **`/audio-install`**（`/` 菜单里能看到，带说明）
- 它会告诉你：要下约 **470 MB**（librosa + onnxruntime + 16 MB 模型），大概几分钟，走国内镜像
- 装完再输入 **`/audio-status`** 可以确认状态

不想点也行，直接跟 DSH 说："帮我把音频插件的引擎装好"——它会自己从头装到尾，不用你敲命令。

之后每次分析只要几秒。

---

## 怎么问

不用记命令，像跟人说话就行：

- "这首歌怎么样？"
- "副歌在哪？哪一段最满？"
- "2:40 到 3:10 这段怎么回事？"
- "速度多少？什么调？"
- "这歌是什么风格？"

追问 **"为什么"** 会给数字；追问 **"像什么"** 会给方向，并标上"这是推断"。

还有个好用的问法：**"如果我猜错了，应该听到什么？"** —— 它会给你一个反证条件，你听一遍就能否掉。

---

## 一句提醒

这是个**轻量**插件，没有大模型撑着。

结构、速度、响度、调性这些硬信息，它说得比较准；乐器和风格只能给方向——别拿它当严谨鉴定，尤其别拿它断中文乐器和细分流派。

---

## 许可

MIT。

第三方依赖与模型（librosa、scipy、onnxruntime、YAMNet 等）的许可见 [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。

plugins.description: Updates and plugin management UI for the DeepSeek Harness Windows desktop app: a sidebar entry, a panel and a Settings section, driven by the app's native bridge.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-desktop-updates

**A DeepSeek Harness plugin that renders the Updates UI of the Windows desktop app: a row beside Settings, an Updates panel, and an Updates section, driven by the app's native page bridge.**

![MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green)
![platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-Web%20UI-1f6feb)
![dsh](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh-0.1.x-1f6feb)
![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-plugin-desktop-updates)
![status](https://img.shields.io/badge/status-maintained%20for%20an%20archived%20app-orange)

It shows the desktop app's version, the installed and published harness versions, and the plugins this home
runs — with the actions to check, download, install, restart, repair the harness, and enable, disable, install
or remove plugins.

> **Project status:** 1.3.0, published on npm. Verified against the DeepSeek Harness **0.1.5-rc.x** runtime
> that the Windows desktop app bundles. **The desktop app it serves is archived**, and this plugin depends on
> that app's own page bridge (`window.__dshDesktop`), which the official DeepSeek Harness desktop app does not
> provide. In the official app the plugin loads and renders, but reports that the bridge is unavailable —
> because it is. See §Why this exists.

## Screenshots

The UI appears in the desktop app that bundles it. Screenshots of the app window, including the Updates panel,
are in
[the app repository](https://github.com/desanv01/deepseek-harness-desktop-app#screenshots).

## Why this exists

The app needed a settings surface — the app's version, whether the harness was current, what plugins this home
runs, and buttons to act on all of it — without rebuilding a native window for every change. The app already
rendered the harness web UI in WebView2, so the surface became a plugin: sidebar row, panel and Settings
section, all in the page the user is already looking at.

That decision had one consequence worth stating. The facts and the actions live in the **app**, not the page,
so the page needs a channel back to it. The app injects a versioned bridge, `window.__dshDesktop`, into every
page it loads, and this plugin is the only consumer of it.

**That bridge is the reason this plugin is tied to one app.** The official DeepSeek Harness desktop app ships
its own plugin manager and its own updates view; it does not expose `__dshDesktop`. Installed there, this plugin
registers its slots and then reports that it cannot reach the app — which is accurate, and better than a panel
that looks live and does nothing.

## What it does

- **A row beside Settings** in the sidebar — a labelled entry (an icon in the 56 px rail) that opens the Updates
  panel, with a dot when a newer app build exists.
- **A panel**, full view, in the app's own window: the facts plus check, download, install, restart and
  repair, and the plugin list with enable, disable, install and remove.
- **A Settings section** with the same facts and actions in a narrower form.
- **Reports what the shell refused.** The shell drops a slot registration it dislikes without telling anyone, so
  a plugin whose UI never appears looks exactly like one that never loaded. This plugin publishes what it
  registered — and every refusal — to `window.__dshDesktopUpdates` and to the app's log.
- **Degrades honestly.** With no bridge, it says the app is unavailable instead of pretending the panel works.

## How it works

### The four slots it contributes

| Slot | Entry | What it renders |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sidebar.footer.action` | id `desktop-updates` | A labelled row beside Settings (an icon in the 56 px rail) that opens the Updates panel; a dot when a newer app build exists |
| `sidebar.panellist` | id `desktop-updates` | The sidebar row for the Updates panel, addressed by the same id as the body below |
| `main` | key `desktop-updates` | The Updates panel itself: the full view, in the app's own window |
| `settings.section` | id `desktop-updates` | The concise view inside Settings, with the same facts and actions |

The three list slots require an `id` and the keyed `main` slot requires a `key`; the shell rejects a
registration that omits either.

### Opening the panel is a layout action, not a bridge call

The plugin selects its own panel through `ctx.layout.selectPanel`, so the view appears in the window the user
is already looking at, and opening it cannot fail because the bridge is unavailable. When the shell has no
panel slot to select, it falls back to the app's native updates window — the same window the tray menu opens.

### The registration marker

`client.js` writes `window.__dshDesktopUpdates` as it applies: the slots it registered and every contribution
the shell refused. The app reads that marker after each page load and logs it. The Updates section repeats any
refusal, because that is the only place a user would see it.

### Version skew

The app leaves an installed version alone when it is newer than the copy inside its executable, so a newer npm
release is not undone by the next launch. `DeepSeekHarness.exe --install-plugin` restores the bundled copy
deliberately.

## Requirements

- A DeepSeek Harness **0.1.x** composition with the `layout` service — the runtime the Windows desktop app
  bundles.
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-layout`, declared in `dsh.client.inject`, which the host must provide.
- For anything to be actionable: the desktop app's `window.__dshDesktop` bridge.

## Quick start

### Install from npm

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-desktop-updates
```

### Install into the desktop app

The app installs its bundled copy by itself, into the harness home it owns. From inside the app, use
**Settings → Updates → the plugin manager**, which accepts a package name, a git spec or a local folder.
Installing from npm replaces the bundled copy with the published one.

### Build from source

Nothing to build — the client half is a hand-written module-face bundle:

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/desanv01/dsh-plugin-desktop-updates.git
cd dsh-plugin-desktop-updates
dsh plugin --profile web add .
```

### Smoke test

The client half can be rendered headlessly against a fake shell; that is how the desktop app's own CI checks
it, with `tools/client-plugin-smoke.mjs` in
[the app repository](https://github.com/desanv01/deepseek-harness-desktop-app). It loads the real `client.js`,
enforces the real slot rules (a list entry needs an `id`, the panel slot needs a `key`) and fails if a
registration is dropped.

## Configuration

None. The plugin reads no `Config` values; it renders what the bridge reports.

## Slots used

See the four-slot table in §How it works. `main` is keyed; the other three are addressed by `id`.

## Where things live

| Piece | Path |
| --- | --- |
| Host half | `index.js` — an empty `apply`, so the row exists in the profile's bundle stack and the loader keeps it |
| Browser half | `client.js` — a module-face bundle (`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })`) |
| Loader row | `cordis.patch.yml` — inserts the row `desktop-updates` |
| Registration marker | `window.__dshDesktopUpdates`, plus the app's log |
| Bridge it consumes | `window.__dshDesktop`, injected by the app |

## Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Cause | Fix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| No sidebar row at all | The bundle row is missing from the profile, or the client half was not served | Check `cordis.patch.yml` is installed, then read `window.__dshDesktopUpdates` in the page |
| Row appears, panel says the app is unavailable | No `window.__dshDesktop` — this is the expected result outside the Windows desktop app | Use the app that provides the bridge |
| Row appears, panel is empty | The bridge exists but reported no state | Check the app's log for the marker it logs after each page load |
| Settings section missing but the panel works | The shell refused the `settings.section` registration | The section repeats refusals; the marker lists them |
| A newer npm version did not take effect | The app keeps an installed version newer than its bundled copy | See §Version skew |

## Current status

Working, for the app it was built for.

Verified: the four slot registrations

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 用の日本語ネイティブ TUI（設計段階 / design phase）
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH-forJP-TUI

DeepSeek Harness (dsh) のための**日本語ネイティブ TUI**。

> **状態: Phase 0（走路骨格）完了。描画は未着手。**
> 自作バンドルが DSH の Cordis 木に載り、自前の入口（C）から起動し、C が壊れれば
> `dsh --profile` 子プロセス（B）へフォールバックし、`session/event` の生イベントを捕捉できる。
> 検証は `node scripts/verify-bundle.mjs`（12検査）。

## これは何か

dsh の TUI サーフェスを、日本語を第一級に扱う形で自作する。
既存の [dsh-TUI](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI) を参考にしつつ、
コードは共有せず、描画層から自分で設計する。

## 目的

| # | 目的 | 設計要求 |
|---|---|---|
| P1 | 見た目を自分で設計できる | 描画層を自前で握る。装飾演出を既定で入れない |
| P2 | 日本語ネイティブ | 文言を最初からカタログ化。日本語を言語パックに追い出さない |
| P3 | 上流更新で崩れにくい | 依存する上流の非公開契約を最小化し、その数を常時計測する |
| P4 | UX 研究の土台 | UI 層とハーネス層を分離し、UI の反復試行を安くする |
| P5 | 将来ハーネスごと差し替える（思想として保持） | ハーネス境界を1箇所に閉じ込める |
| P6 | ハーネスチューニング研究 | ハーネスの挙動を外から差し替え可能に保つ |

## 確定している方針

- **DSH への載せ方**: in-process の Cordis バンドル（`dsh.bundle.patch`）。承認・ユーザー質問・モデル切替を
  人対話で行うには、これ以外の経路が存在しない（公式 SDK / ACP には承認チャネルが無い）
- **起動**: 自前のフル host-entry を持つ。ただし**失敗時は必ず `dsh --profile` 子プロセスへフォールバック**する
- **描画層**: upstream の [Ink](https://github.com/vadimdemedes/ink) **v8.0.0**（commit `26d2c3f8`）を fork し、
  `src/ink/` に置いて自前で拡張する。Ink 本体はマウス選択・ヒットテスト・スクロール固定を持たないため、
  これらは自作する
- **v0 の範囲**: 入力解析 / 差分描画 / 全角幅 / 入力欄 / ストリーム表示 / ツールカード /
  承認パネル / ユーザー質問パネル / セッション結線 / 中断と終了

## ドキュメント

> **作業を引き継ぐ場合は [`docs/HANDOFF.md`](docs/HANDOFF.md) を先に読んでください。**
> 今の状態・動かし方・アーキテクチャ・DSH の API で実測した落とし穴・既知の穴・次の課題が
> そこに集約されています。

| 文書 | 内容 |
|---|---|

調査ノートには**環境依存のローカル絶対パスをマスク**してある（`$HOME/<workspace>/...`）。

## 開発

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm build
node scripts/verify-bundle.mjs          # 構造検査（A〜D）
COMMANDCODE_API_KEY=... node scripts/verify-bundle.mjs   # 実モデル実行まで（E）
```

検証は `$HOME/.dsh` に**一切書き込まない**。`DSH_HOME` をワークスペース内の `.dsh-home/` に向けて
プロファイルとバンドル解決を完結させる（[理由](docs/research/2026-10-18-sandbox-and-dsh-home.md)）。

入口は `lib/bin.js`（`dsh-forjp`）。環境変数で挙動を切り替えられる:

| 変数 | 値 | 意味 |
|---|---|---|
| `FORJP_ENTRY` | `auto`（既定） | C を試し、失敗したら B へフォールバック |
| | `in-process` | C のみ。失敗したら異常終了 |
| | `child` | B を強制 |
| `FORJP_PROFILE` | 既定 `forjp` | プロファイル名 |
| `DSH_FORJP_HOST_PACKAGE` | 未設定 | ホスト `@deepseek-ai/dsh` のパッケージディレクトリを明示 |

## ライセンス

MIT（[`LICENSE`](LICENSE)）。

fork 元の [Ink](https://github.com/vadimdemedes/ink) も MIT であり、`src/ink/` に取り込む時点で
Ink のライセンス表示を同梱する。

## TUI を起動する（縦切り v0.1）

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm build
pnpm profile:install                 # $DSH_HOME（既定 ~/.dsh）へプロファイルを設置
COMMANDCODE_API_KEY=... dsh --profile forjp-tui
```

- 入力して `Enter` で送信、`Ctrl+C` または `Esc` 2回で終了
- 動作確認（PTY 上で起動→入力→応答→終了までを実測する）: `pnpm test:ui`
- **別の版の DSH で動くか**: `pnpm verify:host --host <dsh のパッケージディレクトリ>`
- 作業用の隔離環境へ入れる場合: `pnpm profile:install --home .dsh-home`

plugins.readme_text:
# 红队评审台（Red-Team Review Console）

给 DeepSeek Harness 的一个持久插件（bundle），把「对抗式挑刺 → 独立打分 → 修复 → 复评」做成可复用闭环：

```
建设者 AI 做项目（任意工作区）
   │
   ├─ adversarial_review_round（Host 工具）
   │    1. Host 用无头 Chrome 渲染恰好 4 张被评审 UI 的证据截图
   │    2. 启动「红队」子智能体（fresh 会话、只读、只证伪）挑刺
   │    3. 启动「判官」子智能体（另一个 fresh 会话，只拿红队报告）打分 0–100
   │    4. 返回 gate：总分 ≥95 + 有效发现 ≥3 + 截图 =4 + mustFix 为空 才 passed
   │
   ├─ 未通过：按判官 mustFix/扣分项修复项目，再次调用工具
   └─ 通过：允许交付/停止
```

## 交付物

| 文件 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Host 插件行 + 单一统一 Agent 预设（`redteam-console`：主会话可读写/执行；被评审台作为子代理时由 guard 强制只读；红队/判官角色由每轮任务提示区分） |
| `index.js` + `lib/` | Host：子智能体编排、4 张截图渲染、状态持久化、门控 guard、HTTP 数据接口 |
| `client.js` | Web GUI 原生面板：侧栏「红队评审台」+ 整页看板（门控横幅 / 轮次时间线 / 发现 / 评分明细 / 4 张截图） |
| `locale/`、`icon.svg` | 插件元数据与图标（中/英） |
| `CONTRACT.md` | 实现契约（接口、状态模型、门控规则） |
| `docs/UPGRADE-PLAN.md` | 问题清单（S/B/E/G/M/P 六类、带严重度）+ v1.1→v2.0 升级实施计划 |
| `test/` | 纯逻辑单测（`node --test`） |

演示对象是 `../demo-tarot-app/`（一个刻意埋了缺陷的静态站），用来真实跑完整闭环。

## 安装

在 Harness 会话中由具备权限的 Agent 执行：

```
plugin_manager install_bundle, target = C:\Users\zl\Documents\deepseek-harness\default-workspace\redteam-console
```

安装后：

- 侧栏出现「红队评审台」入口，点开是整页看板；
- 新会话的 Agent 预设选择器出现「对抗审查（红队）」「独立评分（判官）」两个独立预设；
- 所有 Agent 的工具列表出现 `adversarial_review_round` / `adversarial_review_status`；评审子智能体另有专属只读工具 `review_probe`（其他 Agent 调用会被拒绝）。

> 本地目录安装是 link 方式：改完代码需要重新 `install_bundle` 才会加载新的 Host 代码；Client 代码刷新页面生效。已有会话保持旧组合。

## 使用（任意项目）

对一个做完的项目执行一轮：

```json
{
  "target": "C:\\path\\to\\your\\project",
  "title": "项目名（可选）",
  "claims": ["README 里宣称做到的事 1", "宣称 2"],
  "focus": ["正确性", "前端密钥", "可访问性"],
  "environment": "可运行已有测试，无需联网",
  "timeBudget": "20 分钟或 40 次工具调用",
  "shots": [
    { "path": "index.html", "width": 1440, "height": 900, "name": "home-desktop" },
    { "path": "shop.html", "width": 1440, "height": 900, "name": "shop" },
    { "path": "reading.html", "width": 1440, "height": 900, "name": "reading" },
    { "path": "index.html", "width": 390, "height": 844, "name": "home-mobile" }
  ]
}
```

- `shots` 必须恰好 4 条（每轮固定 4 张证据截图）；留空则自动探测 `index.html` 等入口并用 4 个视口渲染；完全找不到 Web UI 时，先渲染 4 张中性占位报告页供评审引用，评分结束后用完整本轮结果重新渲染同一批 4 张。
- **`evidence`（v1.2，与 `shots` 二选一）**：恰好 4 张证据卡，`kind` 支持 `"screenshot" | "interaction" | "image" | "pdf-text"`。`interaction` 卡可写 `path`/`url` + `width`/`height` + `steps`（`goto` / `wait` / `click` / `key` / `screenshot`，最多 20 步）+ `collect:{console,network,perf}`，Host 用零依赖 CDP runner 真实操作页面，产出多帧截图与 console/network/perf 摘要；`image` 把项目内 PNG 图表拷入证据目录并校验尺寸/sha256；`pdf-text` 零依赖抽取论文 PDF 指定页文本，渲染成证据页并附 `.txt` 全文。每卡至少 1 张图，门控仍要求 4 张代表图。
- `profile` 支持 `code`（默认）/`web`/`game`/`modeling`，可按轮传参覆盖；`game` 注入游戏 rubric，`modeling` 注入建模 rubric（可复现性/数据泄漏/指标口径/基线/图表一致性等）。建模项目可在根目录放 `modeling-run.json`（声明复现命令 + metricsFile），评审者用 `review_probe run-metrics` 在只读临时副本真实执行并对比指标。
- **生命周期模式（v1.3）**：已通过 cycle 不会就地重审；再次评审用 `mode:"reopen"`（新 cycle、轮数重置）或 `mode:"incremental"`（基于上一通过轮快照只强制检查变更文件 + 回归抽样；无基线文件清单时自动降级全量并 warning）。`adversarial_review_batch` 可一次顺序评审 2–`maxBatchTargets` 个 target，单 target 失败不中断。
- **只读运维看板（v1.3）**：搜索/状态筛选/排序；概览、轮次、发现（降噪 suppressed/mustFix 去重）、证据（代表图 + 额外帧 + PDF 文本 artifact）、成本、导出（MD/JSON）页签；SSE 阶段进度与取消按钮；轮次 diff（new/repeat/fixed/severity-changed）；不提供 accept/reject/waive 人工处置。
- **v2.0 可信评分体系**：`judgeModels` 多模型判官路由（≤3，逐样本审计）、`scoreStats`（mean/median/stdev/CI95 bootstrap）、20 项目校准语料（`benchmarks/`，4 种子 + 16 corpus 微基准，82 条 path:line 标签，`corpus/generate.mjs --check` 可确定性重建）、校准脚本 `node benchmarks/calibrate.mjs`、漂移脚本 `node benchmarks/drift.mjs --baseline benchmarks/baseline.json`；评分口径见 [docs/SCORING-RUBRIC.md](docs/SCORING-RUBRIC.md)，最终验收见 [docs/ACCEPTANCE-REPORT.md](docs/ACCEPTANCE-REPORT.md)。live 校准 5 fixture：recall 100% / precision 92% / gate 一致 5/5，mean 47.8、CI95 [40.6,55]。
- 例：`{"target":"...", "profile":"game", "evidence":[{"kind":"interaction","path":"index.html","steps":[{"action":"goto"},{"action":"click","selector":"#start"},{"action":"screenshot","name":"playing"}],"collect":{"console":true,"perf":true}}, {"kind":"screenshot","path":"index.html","name":"desktop"}, ...]}`。
- 工具返回 `gate`：`passed=false` 时按 `score.mustFix` / `score.deductions[].fix` 修复后再次调用；`passed=true` 才能停。
- 判官独立评分（**默认 2 个独立判官**）：红队看不到判官、判官看不到红队推理、判官之间互不可见、都看不到建设者的上下文；聚合规则是保守的——分数取中位数（偶数取较低值），`mustFix` 取并集，有效发现数取「所有判官都 supported 的交集 ∪ 任一判官 supported 的 BLOCKER/MAJOR 阻断并集」去重后的数量，任一判官认定 supported 的 BLOCKER/MAJOR 都会阻断门控；判官分歧（分差 >5、mustFix/verdict 不一致）记入 `disagreement` 供审计，不改变门控。模型调用全部发生在 Host 侧，**前端不接触任何 API key**。
- 每轮记录审计字段：`rubricVersion`、攻击者/判官 prompt 的 sha256、请求的模型路由（未配置则记录继承）、判官原始分 `rawScore`、判官原始输出摘要、每个判官的独立结果 `judges[]`、`judgeSessionIds[]`。

## 门控规则

`gate.passed === true` 当且仅当：

1. 评分 ≥ `requiredScore`（默认 **95**，满分 100，**只向下取整到 0.5 档**：94.5 → 94.5，永远不会因为取整变成 95）；
2. 有效发现（判官 supported）≥ `requiredFindings`（默认 3）；**例外（v2.0 clean-pass）**：**每个**判官样本都明确报告 0 条 supported、无阻断项、`mustFix` 为空且评分 ≥ `requiredScore` 时，视为项目干净，可通过（避免「3 条 MINOR 必然 92.5」与 95 线的数学矛盾；任一样本有 1–2 条发现不适用，避免一个干净判官抹掉另一个判官的发现）；
3. 本轮截图数 = `requiredShots`（默认 4，且是真实可解析 PNG）；
4. 判官 `mustFix` 为空——**mustFix 只包含 BLOCKER/MAJOR 级阻断项**；
5. 判官没有任何 `supported` 的 **BLOCKER 或 MAJOR** 阻断项（评分再高也不能放行）。

评分口径：**95/100** 表示「没有阻断项（无 BLOCKER/MAJOR 残留）且证据充分」，允许保留少量已披露的 MINOR 并小幅扣分（每条 **2.5**，合计 ≤**7.5**）。因此 95 分线最多容忍 2 条 MINOR（3 条 = 92.5 < 95）；BLOCKER/MAJOR 仍然严格卡死。

另有 `tools.guard`：位于评审中的项目，调用者会话在未达标时 `update_goal(action: complete)` 会被拒绝；`present` 提交该项目文件也会被拒绝（可用配置关闭）。

## 配置（`cordis.patch.yml` 的 `adversarial-review-console.config`）

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `requiredScore` | `95` | 停止线（满分 100） |
| `requiredFindings` | `3` | 必须挑出的有效问题数 |
| `requiredShots` | `4` | 每轮证据卡/代表图数量 |
| `profile` | `code` | 领域 profile：`code` / `web` / `game` / `modeling`；game 注入游戏 rubric。可用 tool 参数 `profile` 按轮覆盖 |
| `interactionTimeoutSeconds` | `60` | 单张 interaction 证据卡的 CDP 交互超时（1–600s） |
| `modelingTimeoutSeconds` | `120` | `review_probe run-metrics` 单条声明命令超时（1–600s，总预算 600s） |
| `maxRounds` | `12` | 单 cycle 轮数上限（本 bundle 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 覆盖为 **40**） |
| `roundTimeoutSeconds` | `900` | 单个子智能体超时（红队/判官各自计时；上限 2160s；本 bundle 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 为适配 V4Pro 覆盖为 **1800s**） |
| `childProvider` | `spawn` | 子智能体后端（in-process spawn 才能用 preset） |
| `attackerPreset` / `judgePreset` | `redteam-console` | 统一预设 id（发布前合并；角色由任务提示区分，子代理由 Host guard 强制只读） |
| `judgeSamples` | `2` | 每轮独立判官数量（1–3）；聚合取中位/较低分、mustFix 并集、supported 取交集/阻断并集口径，分歧仅标记 |
| `readOnlyReviewers` | `true` | 评审子智能体硬只读：拒绝 shell/写/交付/联网类工具，fs 读取限制在 target + 本轮证据目录（realpath 二次校验，符号链接越界拒绝），运行测试只能走 `review_probe` |
| `probeTimeoutSeconds` | `120` | `review_probe run-tests` 超时（临时只读副本内执行，离线 env，结束清理） |
| `probeMaxCopyBytes` / `probeMaxCopyFiles` | `104857600` / `20000` | probe 临时副本上限 |
| `attackerProvider/attackerModel/attackerReasoningEffort` | `''` | 可选攻击者模型路由；留空继承父会话。只传 id，不涉及 key |
| `judgeProvider/judgeModel/judgeReasoningEffort` | `''` | 可选判官模型路由；留空继承父会话 |
| `chromePath` | `''` | 留空自动找 Chrome/Edge/ms-playwright Chromium |
| `stateDir` | `''` | 留空用 `$DSH_HOME/adversarial-review` |
| `announceToAgent` | `true` | 是否给所有 Agent 注入使用说明 |
| `enforceGoalGate` / `enforceGateOnPresent` | `true` | 未达标时拦截 stop/交付 |
| `goalGateRoots` | `[]` | 只对列出的交付根（精确匹配，不含其子目录）执行 `update_goal(complete)` 门禁；未列出的根不阻塞完成；空 = 本会话评审过的全部根。校准/演示 fixture 可排除，避免故意失败样本永久阻塞 goal |

## 演示闭环结果（本 profile 实测）

对 `demo-tarot-app/` 真实跑了 **5 轮**对抗评审（每轮固定 4 张截图，共 20 张 PNG，全部由 Host 侧无头浏览器渲染并校验）。下表中的分数为旧 10 分制轮次按 **×10** 迁移后的 100 分制显示（`rubricVersion: legacy-10`），规则与现在不完全相同，仅作历史记录：

| 轮次 | 红队发现 | 判官独立评分 | 门控 | 处理 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| R1 | 18 条（含 BLOCKER/MAJOR） | **60 / 100** BLOCK | ✗ | 18 项 mustFix 全部修复 |
| R2 | 6 条（判官驳回 1 条过度指控） | **85 / 100** HOLD | ✗ | 6 项修复（数量接线/焦点/live/移动菜单/内边距/文档） |
| R3 | 5 条（1 MAJOR + 4 MINOR） | **85 / 100** HOLD | ✗ | 5 项修复（测试口径/焦点/缩略图/空购物袋/文案） |
| R4 | 5 条（1 MAJOR + 4 MINOR） | **85 / 100** HOLD | ✗ | 1 MAJOR + 4 MINOR 修复（真实 click 集成测试/隐私日期/运费文案/焦点陷阱/缩略图断言） |
| R5 | 4 条（全部 MINOR，无阻断项） | **95 / 100** PASS | ✓ | `mustFix=[]`，`gate.passed=true`，停止 |

**历史演示（Phase 0 时）**：当时 `node test/run-all.js` 28/28、插件单测 86/86（含前端静态契约 95/95）；当前测试入口为 `node test/run-all.mjs`，Host **338/338**、含客户端契约 **366/366**（run-all.mjs 366/366），证据截图在 `$DSH_HOME/adversarial-review/shots/<cycleId>/`。

**评分口径说明**：新规则为 100 分制、95 分

# dsh-rea-toggle

[English](#english) · [中文](#中文)

One switch per conversation that decides whether the **REA**
(`reverse-engineer-anything`) MCP server's context reaches the model at all.

REA registers **207 tool schemas** plus a multi-kilobyte server-instructions
block. `dsh-mcp-client` puts both on the **global** layer, so every agent pays
for them on every request — whether or not the turn has anything to do with
reverse engineering.

With this plugin installed, a small pill appears below the composer:

- **REA on** (green) — exactly the pre-install behaviour. REA's tools and
  instructions are visible to the model.
- **REA off** (grey) — those 207 tool schemas and the `mcp:rea` instructions
  block **leave the model context**, taking effect on the next step.

**The switch is per conversation.** Each conversation remembers its own
position, and a new conversation starts **off**. That is the whole point: a
conversation about a web app should not pay for 207 reverse-engineering schemas
just because some other conversation needs them. Subagents inherit the position
of the conversation that created them, so delegating inside reverse-engineering
work does not silently break the subagent.

The same switch is on the keyboard: `/rea off`, `/rea on`, `/rea status`,
`/rea toggle` — all acting on the conversation you typed them in.

Nothing is uninstalled and nothing restarts. The MCP connection stays up; the
model simply stops being told those tools exist.

---

## English

### What it actually does

The token cost comes from two different places that travel two different paths,
so one mechanism is not enough:

| Target | Mechanism |
| --- | --- |
| Tool schemas | `tools.restrict({ deny })` is called **in each agent's own context**. `ToolRuntime.view()` filters what that scope *inherits* from the global layer, and the model-facing schema list is rebuilt from that view on every assembly. The reserved `run_code` transport sits outside the filterable layers, so it is unaffected. |
| Instructions text | `dsh-mcp-client` registers the server instructions as a prompt section named `mcp:<server>` at order `MCP_SERVERS` (3100). **A scoped section with the same name shadows the global one** — a documented contract of `systemPrompt.section()` ("a scoped section shadows a global section with the same name"), not an implementation detail — and an empty section is dropped at render (`renderPrompt` keeps only `text.length > 0`). Registering that name and returning `''` therefore removes the block for that agent alone. |

Both are scoped registrations, so disposing them restores the previous state
exactly. That is why flipping the switch needs no restart and no reload.

Coverage includes **subagents**: `agent/created` is serial and awaited by the
registry, so installing inside it lands ahead of any prompt assembly.

### Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:aurumple/dsh-rea-toggle
```

Or point at a checkout:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-rea-toggle
```

The bundle row id is `rea-toggle`; the package name is `dsh-rea-toggle`.

### Use

| Where | What |
| --- | --- |
| Pill under the composer | Click to flip **this conversation**. Green = on, grey = off, red border = the host did not answer. |
| `/rea off` · `/rea on` | Set this conversation's position. `enable` / `disable` work too. |
| `/rea toggle` | Flip this conversation. |
| `/rea status` | Report this conversation's position. |

A new conversation starts off. The first time you turn one on, that conversation
is remembered; conversations you never touch stay on the default and are not
written down.

Positions are remembered in `$DSH_HOME/rea-toggle.json` (usually
`~/.dsh/rea-toggle.json`), keyed by session id, and survive a restart. The file
keeps the 500 most recently changed conversations; an older one simply falls
back to the default.

### Configuration

Every field is optional.

```yaml
- id: rea-toggle
  name: dsh-rea-toggle
  config:
    server: rea               # one MCP server to govern; default "rea"
    # servers: [rea, ghidra]  # or several; wins over `server` when present
    # defaultEnabled: true    # new conversations start ON instead of off
```

Changing `server` governs a different MCP server by the same rules: tool prefix
`mcp__<server>__`, instructions section `mcp:<server>`. Because the mechanism is
generic, this works for any MCP server whose tools are bridged by
`dsh-mcp-client` — the REA case is just the one that motivated it.

`defaultEnabled` exists for anyone who wants the pre-plugin behaviour back: with
it on, a conversation nobody has switched behaves exactly as if this plugin were
not installed.

### HTTP API

The Client half talks to the Host over one exact route on the bare `webServer`
(the same shape other bundles use, so it does not travel through the `/api`
prefix fence). The conversation is `session=` on GET and a body field on POST:
the pill always knows which conversation it is showing, and a request that does
not say cannot be answered for it.

```
GET  /rea-toggle/state?session=<id>
  -> { session, enabled, known, defaultEnabled, servers, agents, tools, statePath }

GET  /rea-toggle/state            (no session: a summary)
  -> { session: null, defaultEnabled, servers, conversations, agents, tools, statePath }

POST /rea-toggle/state
  body: { "session": "<id>", "enabled": true | false }   (omit `enabled` to flip)
  -> the per-conversation status object
```

`known` says whether this conversation has ever been switched; when it is
`false`, `enabled` is just `defaultEnabled` and nothing has been written yet.
`agents` is how many live agents of that conversation are currently covered;
`tools` is how many of the governed server's tools were recognised, which is the
honest answer to "did it find REA at all" — if it reads `0`, the server is not
connected under that name (and stays `0`-safe because `restrictableNames` is the
denyable set, not the filtered view).

### Scope and limits

- **One server per row by default.** Other MCP servers are untouched; use
  `servers` to govern more than one.
- **Hidden, not unloaded.** The MCP connection stays up and the REA process
  keeps running. When the switch is off the model simply cannot reach it —
  including indirectly through `run_code`. That is deliberate: leaving a second
  path open would save only half the tokens.
- **Per-conversation state, in-process.** Positions are read from the file at
  `apply()` and written on every change. Two DSH instances sharing one profile
  each read it once and do not live-sync with each other.
- **It does not delete anything.** Turning it off is reversible in one click,
  and uninstalling the bundle lifts every registration.

### Verify it yourself

The claim is that the tools are gone from the model's context, not merely
hidden in a UI. Check it where the model's own view is exposed:

1. With the switch **on**, ask the agent to list its tools — `mcp__rea__*`
   entries are there (207 of them for a stock REA install).
2. Turn it **off**, ask again — they are gone, and calling one by name returns
   `Error: unknown tool "mcp__rea__binary_session"`.
3. Turn it back **on** — they return, unchanged.
4. Open a **second conversation** and check its tool list: it is off, while the
   first one is still on. That is the property that distinguishes this plugin
   from a global toggle.

### Development

```bash
npm test        # node:test, no dependencies
```

The suite drives the real `apply()` against a small model of the three
contracts it depends on (tool view, prompt section merge, agent registry). It
pins what "off" removes, that "on" restores the previous state exactly, that a
new subagent is covered before its first step, that the position survives a
restart, and that the HTTP surface validates its input.

### License

MIT

服务器的上下文是否进入模型。

REA 注册了 **207 个工具 schema**，外加一段几千字的服务端说明。
`dsh-mcp-client` 把它们放在**全局层**，所以每个 agent、每次请求都在为它们付
token —— 不管这一轮到底要不要逆向。

plugins.description: Codex-style Windows computer use for DeepSeek Harness: UI Automation + screenshots + SendInput, liquid-glass screen overlay, ESC kill switch. Install: dsh plugin --profile web add github:esch30636/dsh-computer-use
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-computer-use

[![GitHub release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/esch30636/dsh-computer-use?sort=semver)](https://github.com/esch30636/dsh-computer-use/releases)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-4B5563)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)

Codex-style **Windows computer use** for DeepSeek Harness: window-targeted UI Automation + occlusion-tolerant screenshots + SendInput mouse/keyboard injection, exposed as five model-facing tools and backed by a bundled long-lived PowerShell helper.

While computer use is active, a click-through **screen overlay** draws a vivid "liquid glass" look: a sapphire *edge vignette* (fully clear center, satin-navy darkening toward the four screen edges) with a thin cyan glass rim hugging the display border, plus a "dynamic island" status pill at the top center — sapphire gradient, diagonal sheen, bright rim, breathing blue glow: `DeepSeek Harness 正在操控你的电脑 | 按 ESC 终止`. Pressing **ESC** stops computer use immediately and closes the overlay; the agent is told to stop and reports back.

Designed after the OpenAI Codex Windows Computer Use surface (`list_apps` / `get_window_state` / `click(element_index | x,y)` / `press_key` / `type_text` / `scroll` / `drag` / `set_value` / `activate_window`, X11-keysym-style key names, one action then re-observe), reimplemented as a pure DSH plugin with no third-party runtime dependencies.

## What you get

| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `computer_list_windows` | List targetable top-level windows (window_id, process identity, title, rect, foreground/minimized, policy-blocked flag). Optionally lists Start-menu launchable apps. |
| `computer_observe` | Capture one window state: screenshot (default) and/or UI Automation tree with element indexes, focused element, selection, document text. Returns `state_id` + screenshot coordinate mapping. |
| `computer_action` | Exactly one action against a state: click / double_click / right_click / middle_click / mouse_move / type / key / scroll / drag / set_value / wait / activate_window. |
| `computer_launch_app` | Launch by exe path, exe name, Start-menu display name, `.lnk`, or `shell:AppsFolder\<AUMID>`; reports the windows it opened. |
| `computer_sequence` | Run up to 100 ordered input steps on one window without re-observing between them (absolute screen pixels) — for repetitive GUI work such as drawing a diagram; optionally returns one verification screenshot. |

Plus the click-through status overlay with the **ESC kill switch** (`USER_ESCAPE`), a system-prompt section (workflow, hard denies, confirmation policy) and a `computer-use` skill with the full playbook.

## Requirements

- Windows 10/11, interactive user session (not a service session), PowerShell 5.1 (`powershell.exe` — pwsh 7 not required).
- DSH 0.2.x (web/desktop profile; any composition that mounts `tools`, `systemPrompt` and `attachments` — the shipped base mounts all three).
- No native modules, no npm dependencies, no MCP server.

## Install

### Option A — DSH CLI (`dsh plugin add`)

For profiles the `dsh` CLI can manage (`web`, `tui`, `headless`, …), the plugin
installs as a regular DSH bundle:

```sh
# straight from GitHub (pnpm fetches the repo tarball)
dsh plugin --profile web add github:esch30636/dsh-computer-use

# or from the release tarball (no git fetch; works behind a GitHub proxy too)
dsh plugin --profile web add "https://github.com/esch30636/dsh-computer-use/releases/latest/download/dsh-computer-use.tgz"
```

`dsh plugin` installs the package into the profile and enables its bundle.
Restart the host (or let HMR recompose) and the `computer_*` tools appear in a
new session.

### Option B — Desktop app (`desktop` profile)

The Desktop app owns its reserved `desktop` profile, so `dsh plugin --profile
desktop` deliberately refuses to run there. Two supported paths:

1. **Plugin market** — after this plugin is listed in
   [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com) (submission pending the
   one-day repository age rule), open **设置 → 插件市场** and install it with one
   click.
2. **Release installer** (works immediately, no git/pnpm needed): download and
   unzip the archive from
   [releases](https://github.com/esch30636/dsh-computer-use/releases), then run
   inside the unzipped folder:

   ```powershell
   # downloads the latest release tarball and installs into the desktop profile
   powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\install-release.ps1
   ```

   Pin a version with `-Version v1.1.0`; target another profile with
   `-Profile web`; add `-Verify` to run the offline composition dump afterwards.

### Option C — manual / fully offline

Download the release archive
([releases](https://github.com/esch30636/dsh-computer-use/releases)), unzip it,
then run the bundled installer:

```powershell
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\install.ps1 -Profile desktop
```

The installer copies the package to `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/dsh-computer-use`, appends `dsh-computer-use` to `dsh.profile.bundles` (backing up `package.json`), and installs the skill to `%USERPROFILE%\.agents\skills\computer-use`. It works for any profile, e.g. `-Profile cu-test`, and `-Verify` dumps the composed profile offline.

Uninstall:

```powershell
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\install.ps1 -Profile desktop -Uninstall
```

> **Note on the package name:** an unrelated npm package already uses the name
> `dsh-computer-use`, so `dsh plugin add dsh-computer-use` would install that one.
> Install this plugin through the GitHub spec or the release tarball URL shown
> above. Windows-only (`os: win32`): the helper drives a real interactive desktop
> session via UI Automation + SendInput.

## Configure

Options go in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (the row id is `computer-use`):

```yaml
- id: computer-use
  config:
    # extra process names/paths to deny (built-in denies always stay unless an
    # allow-* escape hatch is enabled)
    blockedProcesses: [msedge.exe]
    # allowlist mode: only these processes may be automated
    # allowedProcesses: [notepad.exe, mspaint.exe]
    screenshotMaxWidth: 1600
    screenshotMaxHeight: 1200
    maxElements: 600
    maxTreeDepth: 12
    idleTimeoutMs: 600000
    startupTimeoutMs: 90000
    requestTimeoutMs: 30000
    confirmRiskyActions: true
    warnWhenApprovalUnavailable: true
    allowWindowsKey: false
    allowTerminalAutomation: false
    keepScreenshots: false
    # screen overlay + ESC kill switch
    overlayEnabled: true
    overlayMessage: "DeepSeek Harness 正在操控你的电脑　|　按 ESC 终止"
    overlayIdleTimeoutMs: 90000
    overlayEdgeOpacity: 55
```

| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `helperPath` | bundled | Override the helper script path. |
| `powershellPath` | `powershell.exe` | PowerShell used to host the helper. |
| `idleTimeoutMs` | `600000` | Kill the idle helper; it restarts on the next call. |
| `startupTimeoutMs` | `90000` | First-call budget (PowerShell start + Add-Type compile). |
| `requestTimeoutMs` | `30000` | Per-request budget once warm (screenshots/UIA use longer internal budgets). |
| `screenshotMaxWidth` / `screenshotMaxHeight` | `1600` / `1200` | Helper-side downscale bounds before the attachment store. |
| `maxElements` / `maxTreeDepth` / `maxTextChars` | `600` / `12` / `20000` | Accessibility tree bounds. |
| `blockedProcesses` / `blockedWindowClasses` | `[]` | Extra denials added to the built-in list. |
| `allowedProcesses` | `[]` | When non-empty: allowlist mode (everything else is denied). |
| `keepScreenshots` | `false` | Keep captured PNGs in `%TEMP%\dsh-computer-use` for debugging. |
| `confirmRiskyActions` | `true` | Ask through `ctx.approval` before destructive/externally visible actions. |
| `warnWhenApprovalUnavailable` | `true` | Under approval policy `never`/no channel: continue with a WARNING instead of failing. Set false for fail-closed. |
| `allowWindowsKey` / `allowTerminalAutomation` | `false` | Escape hatches for the two most dangerous hard denies (still discouraged; the helper keeps its own che

plugins.readme_text:
DSH Mobile — DeepSeek Harness Remote

An open-source Android companion that puts your DeepSeek Harness in your pocket.
Drive sessions, review plans and goals, answer approvals and questions, and get notified when the harness finishes — from your phone, over your network or a relay.

English · 中文 · हिन्दी · Español · Français · ไทย

DSH Mobile is an **unofficial companion app** for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (MIT). It mirrors the web GUI feature for feature and uses the harness's own visual language. Android only, Kotlin + Jetpack Compose. Its companion on the other end is [**dsh-relay**](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-relay), a harness plugin that adds the authentication layer the harness says it lacks, so this app can reach a harness with a real credential and a pinned key instead of an open port. See [Relay](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Relay). **[dshm.zyphite.com](https://dshm.zyphite.com)** is the project site: what the app is, what it looks like, and how to get it running, on one page. Drafts are kept per host and session. - Workspace panels — tabbed text, Markdown, image, PDF and isolated HTML previews; native terminal controls with a bundled xterm renderer; archived-session restore in Settings. - Message feedback — confirmed ratings and retraction, with version-conflict handling. - Slash commands and skills — typing `/` lists the session's commands and skills above the composer. The composer checks a `/` line against the session's own command catalog and runs it through the harness's command gateway. Anything the catalog does not claim is sent as a prompt, which is how skills get invoked. With the dsh-rewind plugin on the host, `/rewind` opens a picker. - Everything the GUI does — goals (phases, rounds, pause/resume/edit), plan mode and plan review, permission approvals, user questions, todo dock, subagents (catalog, follow-ups, interrupt), background jobs, workflow runs, skills, model selection, agent presets, session search, trajectory ledger, session export, message feedback. - Notifications — turn complete, goal complete or blocked, review or question waiting for you. A foreground service keeps the connection alive in the background. - Harness look — the exact DeepSeek Harness design tokens (colors, type, radii, disclosure rows, shimmer, ink buttons), with light, dark and system themes. - 11 languages — English, 中文, हिन्दी, Español, Français, العربية, বাংলা, Português, Русский, اردو, ไทย (RTL aware). ### Added in 0.15.0 - A Check now button for updates in Settings > About. The automatic check also runs again when you come back to the app after a few hours. - Workspace links in replies drawn as file and folder pills; a folder opens in Files. - A redesigned Details panel, Workspace screen and Settings, with archived sessions on a tab of their own. ### Added in 0.14.0 - A `/` menu above the composer with the session's commands and skills. - A picker for the dsh-rewind plugin's `/rewind` and `/undo` that asks for confirmation before it restores files. The transcript hides what a rewind withdrew and marks the cut. ### Added in 0.13.0 - Automation catalog, timing edits, delivery history and session shortcuts. - Plugin installation, updates, toggles, removal, progress and recovery. Create plugin stages an unsent draft with the Creator preset when the host offers it. - Timed questions, continued replies, saved answer drafts and reopenable plans. - Draft text and file, folder and session references saved across app restarts. - Model search, YAML document properties and multiline goal editing. - Reverse-proxy path support and tool argument previews while the model is writing. ## Requirements - Android 8.0+ (minSdk 26). - A running [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) at `0.2.1-alpha.2`, the protocol baseline for DSH Mobile `0.16.0`. Existing protocol fallbacks remain for `0.2.0-rc.1`, `0.1.7-rc.x` and `0.1.6-alpha.x`; new management features need host support. See [compatibility](docs/COMPATIBILITY.md) and the [0.13.0 validation status](docs/VALIDATION-0.13.0.md) for what has been checked on this baseline. ## Quick start 1. Install the latest APK from [Releases](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/releases/latest). 2. Open the app and choose how to connect. Relay and local network are two different setups, not two settings of one, so pick the one that matches wha

plugins.description: Native Rapid-MLX provider for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — dsh reads model facts from the server instead of your settings.yaml.
plugins.readme_text:
# @raullenchai/dsh-provider

A native [Rapid-MLX](https://github.com/raullenchai/Rapid-MLX) provider for
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) — so `dsh`
gets its model facts from the server instead of from whatever you typed into
`settings.yaml`.

[![CI](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

> **Status: published to npm** as
> [`@raullenchai/dsh-provider`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@raullenchai/dsh-provider).
> The end-to-end `dsh` run in [Verified](#verified) was on an M3 Ultra against
> `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`; `dsh 0.1.0-rc.8` is API-compatible — the `LlmAdapter`
> contract is byte-identical and the only changes are additive — and the
> adapter is re-verified against rc.8 at the protocol and unit-test level.
> DSH is still a developer preview that moves fast, so treat this as tracking
> a moving target, not a frozen compatibility promise.

## What it does for you

DSH can already talk to a local Rapid-MLX server through its generic
`openai-completions` provider. That route works — but it knows nothing about
your model beyond what you hand-wrote:

```yaml
# what the generic route makes you maintain, by hand, per model
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    rapid-mlx:
      baseURL: http://localhost:8000/v1
      defaultContextWindow: 262144      # you looked this up. is it still right?
      models:
        - id: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
          contextWindow: 262144
          reasoningEfforts: {off: none, low: low, medium: medium, high: high}
```

Rapid-MLX's `/v1/models` already publishes all of that and more. This adapter
reads it, so:

**1. Nothing to hand-write, and nothing to re-write when you switch models.**
Swap what `rapid-mlx serve` is running and `dsh` follows. No re-running setup,
no stale numbers.

**2. The reasoning control tells the truth.** Rapid-MLX reports whether a model
actually has a reasoning parser. A model that can't reason no longer shows an
off/low/medium/high selector that does nothing.

**3. Compaction is timed with the capacity that actually fits this Mac, not a
number that drifted.** This is the one that quietly costs you.
`dsh-compaction-basic` asks the provider for the route's capacity and compacts
at `thresholdRatio × capacity` (0.8 by default). The provider prefers the
server's **`max_model_len`** — Rapid-MLX's memory-fitted ceiling (what fits in
unified memory: weights + KV cache), in the vLLM/SGLang-standard field — over
the native `context_window`, and falls back to `context_window` on an older
server that doesn't report it. So compaction is timed to what the machine can
actually hold, not the model's advertised window (which it may not have room
for) and not a hand-written number copied from another model.

## Install

Needs Node ≥ 22.15 (dsh imports Node's Zstd stream API without declaring it)
and a running Rapid-MLX server.

```sh
# From npm:
dsh plugin --profile web add @raullenchai/dsh-provider

# …or straight from source — the package ships plain JS with no build step:
dsh plugin --profile web add github:raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider

export RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8000/v1     # optional; this is the default
dsh web
```

Then point the agent at the route:

```yaml
# $DSH_HOME/settings.yaml
agent-default-model:
  provider: rapid-mlx
  model: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
```

Verified: that command installs and activates as a profile layer against
`dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`. To hack on it locally instead, see
[Local development](#local-development).

## Model management (v0.2.0)

Beyond the provider route, the plugin registers five tools and a `/rapid-mlx`
command so the agent can see and manage models without leaving the session.
The split follows which surface actually owns each fact: served-model facts
come from the structured HTTP `/v1/models`; the download cache and pull/remove
are CLI-only, so those — and only those — shell out to `rapid-mlx` through the
harness subprocess seam.

| Tool | Source | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `rapid_mlx_serving` | HTTP `/v1/models` | The model(s) served right now, deduped, with context window, reasoning/tool parsers, MoE/hybrid, and modalities. |
| `rapid_mlx_cached` | `rapid-mlx models --cached` | Downloaded models and their on-disk size. |
| `rapid_mlx_pull` | `rapid-mlx pull <name>` | Download a model (alias or HF repo id). Cancellable; no fixed deadline. |
| `rapid_mlx_remove` | `rapid-mlx rm -y <name>` | Delete a cached model to free disk. |
| `rapid_mlx_health` | HTTP + `rapid-mlx --version` | API up? CLI reachable? Reported as two independent facts. |

`/rapid-mlx` prints a one-shot overview: health, the served model and its facts,
and total cache disk usage.

The CLI is resolved from the `cliCommand` config (default `rapid-mlx` on
`PATH`, or `$RAPID_MLX_CLI`); set it to an absolute path if the binary is not on
the harness's `PATH`. `rapid_mlx_pull`/`rapid_mlx_remove` are the only tools
that change anything on disk, and they run non-interactively (`rm` is forced
with `-y` because the subprocess seam ignores stdin).

## Verified

Against `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7` on an M3 Ultra:

- Installs and **activates as a profile layer** (no "declares no `dsh.bundle`"
  warning; the entry shows up in `dsh --profile headless --dump-config`).
- Registers the `rapid-mlx` route with `ctx.llm` and serves real queries.
- Plain chat, a single tool call, and the multi-step bug-fix task that gates
  Rapid-MLX releases — the last one fixed the bug and made the target repo's own
  test pass, verified independently, in 36 s on `qwen3.6-35b-8bit`.

## Not done yet

Being explicit, because the point of the adapter is to *use* what the server
says and some of it is still only read:

- `recommended_sampling` — should be applied automatically per model.
- `tool_call_parser` — should let `dsh` fail fast on a model that cannot emit
  `tool_calls`, instead of looping.
- `is_hybrid` / `is_moe` / `capabilities` — read, not yet acted on.
- **Memory-aware capacity.** Today `resolveModel()` reports the model's
  *advertised* context window. On a Mac the real ceiling is unified memory, and
  reporting that instead is the biggest remaining win — it needs Rapid-MLX to
  expose a usable-capacity figure first.
- Images are not carried through `stream()` — but they now **refuse** with
  `LlmError(..., 'UNSUPPORTED')` rather than being dropped, per the cookbook.
  Text, reasoning and tool calls are carried.
- The route is registered as `rapid-mlx`. If your `settings.yaml` also declares
  a `rapid-mlx` provider under `llm-pi-ai`, the two compete for one route name
  (`registerAdapter` owns provider exclusivity). Use one or rename ours.

## Conformance with the official adapter contract

Built against
[`docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/main/docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md)
and its "protocol obligations" section. Each item has a test:

| Obligation | How it is met |
|---|---|
| `usage` before `finish`, nothing after `finish` | usage is buffered and flushed at end-of-stream, so a trailing usage-only chunk cannot reorder it |
| Tool-call `arguments` are raw JSON strings end to end | fragments stream as `argumentsDelta` and reassemble unparsed |
| Block indexes in first-seen order, reused per block | verified across a reasoning-then-text response |
| Errors take exactly two sanctioned paths | transport/protocol failures **throw** `LlmError` with a stable code; nothing ends the stream quietly |
| Honor `options.signal` | passed to `fetch` and to the SSE reader; an `AbortError` is re-thrown unchanged, not reclassified |
| A field the provider cannot honor throws `UNSUPPORTED` | image content refuses instead of being narrowed away |
| Config is a schemastery schema with env fallback | `export const Config`, fed from `cordis.patch.yml` via `!!js process.env.RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL` |

`finish.replayState` is not emitted: Rapid-MLX needs no native response ids
or signatures on follow-up calls, so there is nothing lossless to project.

## Three things worth knowing before you edit this
